Peter, Every single election cycle you hear the same thing: _This is the most important election of our lives. _ Most of the time, that’s hyperbole used to rally Americans into voting – but this year, it’s true. **Taking back the Senate has** _**NEVER**_**been as important as it is now.** _Here’s why, Peter.__
_
---
**💰****OUR NATIONAL DEBT**
---
Right now, our national debt sits at over **$34 TRILLION.****** That equates to more than _$266,000 per taxpayer_ – and that number is growing every single day. **_[**_THIS IS WRONG >>_**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=019bdd03c08b42ec81befc5fa19bf0b2&_e=EpnLki_daq7y-AMc5iAxAIeXlNNbwmXhxpgM1HqHgjncqxA9org4mUpaG9lIyPsv6mG03DGt-A3_qlT62Va9TUafVnsw-xXJf6IDcPu7K2kqg1ddQDSFvs6yVscfPypFkcOUegbUetkq2qjBJURjAuuxlJINlqTW8lCriX77kxVMXa6iY64XlIuKD3CeH8EjJz5uu2o0jI01CAuhIhh-s1pLCCFOkqVXmkIx7jEATqjtUSzRziTp_1RcT4WyABBECDL15J63FDSU5jHBY4I0FJlUV3vo8YQHoFhuD0O0hRHjHZagyHbOfwo28hOcjStLaXe7drTcdmDGpusDCRvlQ9thzKdVQiM7bJq6zHjyF6yLRBw941wprFIYexM9FBHZkSswl2b49jfJVPW2BOFo1XnrXYCVrhRumY8CYZ7zUU4%3D)_** Instead of buckling down, doing the tough work, and reining in wasteful spending, Congress passes spending bill after spending bill, as if money grows on trees.
---
[**REIN IN WASTEFUL SPENDING WITH RAND PAUL**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=019bdd03c08b42ec81befc5fa19bf0b2&_e=EpnLki_daq7y-AMc5iAxAIeXlNNbwmXhxpgM1HqHgjncqxA9org4mUpaG9lIyPsv6mG03DGt-A3_qlT62Va9TUafVnsw-xXJf6IDcPu7K2kqg1ddQDSFvs6yVscfPypFkcOUegbUetkq2qjBJURjAuuxlJINlqTW8lCriX77kxVMXa6iY64XlIuKD3CeH8EjJz5uu2o0jI01CAuhIhh-s1pLCCFOkqVXmkIx7jEATqjtUSzRziTp_1RcT4WyABBECDL15J63FDSU5jHBY4I0FENjkBGZDzxwsaRUsL8ZuZPfYYt-5uqGd0K3CXZqBEEWTQuK4KBz9sdiNksfp_FZ9QpWAw8QO82n_V-3Ok1NA34EUFmC9MJFMaL9cjJJGYucZ0YDSTAVf8bJpOyWnSOaImniOaidYOWm8bkWLI4hqRo%3D)

But the worst part of this entire saga? **We’re borrowing money from our greatest adversary, China.** Peter, that leads me to my next point...
---
| | **🪖****NEVER-ENDING WARS**
---
Members of Congress are so focused on being the world’s police and fixing problems in every other country, that they _**[neglect to solve America’s problems FIRST.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=019bdd03c08b42ec81befc5fa19bf0b2&_e=EpnLki_daq7y-AMc5iAxAIeXlNNbwmXhxpgM1HqHgjncqxA9org4mUpaG9lIyPsv6mG03DGt-A3_qlT62Va9TUafVnsw-xXJf6IDcPu7K2kqg1ddQDSFvs6yVscfPypFkcOUegbUetkq2qjBJURjAuuxlJINlqTW8lCriX77kxVMXa6iY64XlIuKD3CeH8EjJz5uu2o0jI01CAuhIhh-s1pLCCFOkqVXmkIx7jEATqjtUSzRziTp_1RcT4WyABBECDL15J63FDSU5jHBY4I0FH0LsCuzgrHdoezaWE_lPpiDKA9MX2Jhd6Cb_AZqjHlJEI8_3NbDy9-1udxLOtSU8KbsN0NruYenan6Qu4xDIkA21BuK8qDfZhSwdqTV8JkGcRXGpAt_2h-Nx1fnMfmXKV3T4VybdcHub6UFGoSUih4%3D)**_ _Think about it._ We’re borrowing money from China to send to Ukraine, Israel, and every other country that believes we’re nothing more than an ATM. **[**_> >> PUT AN END TO THE NEVER-ENDING WARS WITH RAND <<<_**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=019bdd03c08b42ec81befc5fa19bf0b2&_e=EpnLki_daq7y-AMc5iAxAIeXlNNbwmXhxpgM1HqHgjncqxA9org4mUpaG9lIyPsv6mG03DGt-A3_qlT62Va9TUafVnsw-xXJf6IDcPu7K2kqg1ddQDSFvs6yVscfPypFkcOUegbUetkq2qjBJURjAuuxlJINlqTW8lCriX77kxVMXa6iY64XlIuKD3CeH8EjJz5uu2o0jI01CAuhIhh-s1pLCCFOkqVXmkIx7jEATqjtUSzRziTp_1RcT4WyABBECDL15J63FDSU5jHBY4I0FGSamCAeNqoS01vu-dOAMACpsLA6fkmcOf5TETGMRlB-D3y47e0KPoOrcblTF3jdUfSn50qW7ChK6GN59MjQci4FkuM5F4o5EQpN1-I6fABOAuGxY-2X-sxcBLU8ZJVU287v4QRWz5qfo0NdHZDZV2E%3D)** Any time a conflict breaks out, we’re expected to get involved, pick winners and losers, and fund both sides of a war we have no vested interest in. And it doesn’t matter how much it costs – **either monetarily or with the lives of our Armed Forces** – Washington elites willingly send our sons and daughters into harm’s way. _**[Why are we doing this when it doesn’t protect our national security or benefit Americans in any way?](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=019bdd03c08b42ec81befc5fa19bf0b2&_e=EpnLki_daq7y-AMc5iAxAIeXlNNbwmXhxpgM1HqHgjncqxA9org4mUpaG9lIyPsv6mG03DGt-A3_qlT62Va9TUafVnsw-xXJf6IDcPu7K2kqg1ddQDSFvs6yVscfPypFkcOUegbUetkq2qjBJURjAuuxlJINlqTW8lCriX77kxVMXa6iY64XlIuKD3CeH8EjJz5uu2o0jI01CAuhIhh-s1pLCCFOkqVXmkIx7jEATqjtUSzRziTp_1RcT4WyABBECDL15J63FDSU5jHBY4I0FMHC3hlAC09Cl8-EFUH-XO0SO6g_GWnEAeFPwbBMJOzP56OgeK0CMdyQel98RvFNMusdiUJgqQea59C8cOG2fxCDBrwm_O8A9006OxHZayJhM_6jmlaBS-7e6SHDr7pktF3SmLxhRBq2MrHfQPQgLnA%3D)**_

_Here’s the God’s honest truth, Peter._ **Washington elites make these decisions because it’s NOT their sons or daughters being sent into a war zone.** They’re _NOT_ on the receiving end of a devastating phone call or a visit from a Casualty Notification Officer who informs them a child was killed in action thousands of miles away for an unknown cause. **[**_> >> JOIN RAND: STOP THE FOREVER WARS <<<_**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=019bdd03c08b42ec81befc5fa19bf0b2&_e=EpnLki_daq7y-AMc5iAxAIeXlNNbwmXhxpgM1HqHgjncqxA9org4mUpaG9lIyPsv6mG03DGt-A3_qlT62Va9TUafVnsw-xXJf6IDcPu7K2kqg1ddQDSFvs6yVscfPypFkcOUegbUetkq2qjBJURjAuuxlJINlqTW8lCriX77kxVMXa6iY64XlIuKD3CeH8EjJz5uu2o0jI01CAuhIhh-s1pLCCFOkqVXmkIx7jEATqjtUSzRziTp_1RcT4WyABBECDL15J63FDSU5jHBY4I0FO4nlxt7npNcxBnz1HwjO3Sdm4pP6OZOb4YuMZCb6X5SIBDqws8hXASUT9gH5QSIcSvzQA4y7dCvqQVLapnQmrla2RgfRTZTdKv5K0gAGKsUu2FFLScylRCoDeU6sAR1zLBWzI3_XsIWsLS2qiKF55U%3D)** Peter, these elitists spend **YOUR** hard-earned tax dollars willy-nilly because it’s NOT their checkbooks they have to balance. _After all, they aren’t going to lose their homes or cars if America’s checkbook is in the red.__[**Sure is much different than if you or I treated our personal finances like that, right?**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=019bdd03c08b42ec81befc5fa19bf0b2&_e=EpnLki_daq7y-AMc5iAxAIeXlNNbwmXhxpgM1HqHgjncqxA9org4mUpaG9lIyPsv6mG03DGt-A3_qlT62Va9TUafVnsw-xXJf6IDcPu7K2kqg1ddQDSFvs6yVscfPypFkcOUegbUetkq2qjBJURjAuuxlJINlqTW8lCriX77kxVMXa6iY64XlIuKD3CeH8EjJz5uu2o0jI01CAuhIhh-s1pLCCFOkqVXmkIx7jEATqjtUSzRziTp_1RcT4WyABBECDL15J63FDSU5jHBY4I0FExH07XToSGipQKyI6Dy_y7ANHIFPZjJRAeiB9ADbWhu2Fc60vwezwSCyZcbk4dbgAvnWj27aqTti_LpiotUh--C9gTfjGjqi0Ba1XW9LjoQZw7GXchZKYAEA1JxgCj0BStlW2GCGvSRJtHWpdRlR_s%3D)_ _And that leads me to my final point..._

🔔 ** ****PROTECTING LIBERTY**
---
With all of their crazy spending, forever wars, and constant attacks on the Constitution, Washington elites chip away at liberty, little by little. They collude with Big Tech to censor your thoughts and opinions... They gatekeep and decide what’s fact versus fiction... **They shove Big Government down our throats as the solution to any and every problem.** **[**> >> STAND WITH RAND: PROTECT LIBERTY <<<**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=019bdd03c08b42ec81befc5fa19bf0b2&_e=EpnLki_daq7y-AMc5iAxAIeXlNNbwmXhxpgM1HqHgjncqxA9org4mUpaG9lIyPsv6mG03DGt-A3_qlT62Va9TUafVnsw-xXJf6IDcPu7K2kqg1ddQDSFvs6yVscfPypFkcOUegbUetkq2qjBJURjAuuxlJINlqTW8lCriX77kxVMXa6iY64XlIuKD3CeH8EjJz5uu2o0jI01CAuhIhh-s1pLCCFOkqVXmkIx7jEATqjtUSzRziTp_1RcT4WyABBECDL15J63FDSU5jHBY4I0FPKLMFZKldQkzHxbqfGjBJD24SlOH6zJ72k9LfmqVqYCnSvFOjFYS94LGshLDAmkdgN36cuK_BLmuKsK7bum-gsOwSj-mlVqpT57IlcNtAfUHf7v8ah9UALV1iAGAe1FN3K0VS_j0-BjSfZzVso08lc%3D)** This November, Republicans have an opportunity to show Americans we can – and will – make life better for the American people. **We can show Americans we’ll uphold our Constitutional rights and defend liberty at ALL costs.** **_[**_And all of this starts with taking back the Senate._**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=019bdd03c08b42ec81befc5fa19bf0b2&_e=EpnLki_daq7y-AMc5iAxAIeXlNNbwmXhxpgM1HqHgjncqxA9org4mUpaG9lIyPsv6mG03DGt-A3_qlT62Va9TUafVnsw-xXJf6IDcPu7K2kqg1ddQDSFvs6yVscfPypFkcOUegbUetkq2qjBJURjAuuxlJINlqTW8lCriX77kxVMXa6iY64XlIuKD3CeH8EjJz5uu2o0jI01CAuhIhh-s1pLCCFOkqVXmkIx7jEATqjtUSzRziTp_1RcT4WyABBECDL15J63FDSU5jHBY4I0FNeNW-jso_tBBFZOhG1oFyez5JS5ZPq0h9i0atJ10G2dUo8jfSZERxa2XjL_QK2CSLHHfpgC2zzyXnghs4NENI-xn_xGwi6RLl0hSQPPKPUkGAo6FJZUi8lV27hRxjQTQ7CMkhFPbZ4T0W5oXt_wJkY%3D)_**

* Democrats have **3** **seats to defend** – all in states that voted for President Trump in 2020
* Democrats have **5** **seats to defend** in states Biden won by _3% or less_
* **Voters historically vote for the same party for president and the Senate**

If you would like to unsubscribe, please visit this Peter, Every single election cycle you hear the same thing: This is the most important election of our lives. Most of the time, that’s hyperbole used to rally Americans into voting – but this year, it’s true. Taking back the Senate has NEVERbeen as important as it is now. Here’s why, Peter. 💰OUR NATIONAL DEBT Right now, our national debt sits at over $34 TRILLION.** That equates to more than $266,000 per taxpayer – and that number is growing every single day. Instead of buckling down, doing the tough work, and reining in wasteful spending, Congress passes spending bill after spending bill, as if money grows on trees. But the worst part of this entire saga? We’re borrowing money from our greatest adversary, China. Peter, that leads me to my next point... | | 🪖**NEVER-ENDING WARS Members of Congress are so focused on being the world’s police and fixing problems in every other country, that they Think about it. We’re borrowing money from China to send to Ukraine, Israel, and every other country that believes we’re nothing more than an ATM. Any time a conflict breaks out, we’re expected to get involved, pick winners and losers, and fund both sides of a war we have no vested interest in. And it doesn’t matter how much it costs – either monetarily or with the lives of our Armed Forces – Washington elites willingly send our sons and daughters into harm’s way. Here’s the God’s honest truth, Peter. Washington elites make these decisions because it’s NOT their sons or daughters being sent into a war zone. They’re NOT on the receiving end of a devastating phone call or a visit from a Casualty Notification Officer who informs them a child was killed in action thousands of miles away for an unknown cause. Peter, these elitists spend YOUR hard-earned tax dollars willy-nilly because it’s NOT their checkbooks they have to balance. After all, they aren’t going to lose their homes or cars if America’s checkbook is in the red. You may have seen that Martin’s been busy in the Senate lately — from introducing legislation to establish a refundable tax credit for first-time homebuyers to ensuring public schools have the resources to help students read and write on their grade level. Since he’s been so focused on fighting for working families, he asked our campaign team to help him catch up on fundraising. When we file our quarterly fundraising numbers in a matter of weeks, we’ll soon see how much our campaign raised (and how many supporters gave!) compared to his multi-millionaire opponent. FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE CONTACT: Alan Philp March 14, 2024 [(303) 332-6539](tel:\(303\) 332-6539) | [aphilp@patriotpathways.com](mailto:aphilp@patriotpathways.com) **GABE EVANS BLASTS JENA GRISWOLD’S****ELECTION INTERFERENCE** _Decision to Close Office Friday Affects Who Makes Ballot_ (FORT LUPTON, CO) – Conservative State Representative and Colorado Congressional District 8 candidate Gabe Evans today blasted Secretary of State Jena Griswold for deciding to close her office Friday for a second day. Because signature acceptance rates are higher for candidates who turn in their petitions first, the decision could have major consequences on which candidates make the ballot and which do not. C.R.S. § 1-4-904 specifies that no signer may sign more than one petition for the same office. Petitions are processed in the order they are received and any signature that appears more than once is disqualified from each petition thereafter. “Jena Griswold’s decision to shut down her office at a critical election calendar juncture jeopardizes election integrity,” stated Evans. “Her decision represents election interference, plain and simple. “There is no state of emergency. There is no excuse for entirely closing the Secretary of State’s office for a second straight day tomorrow. At a minimum, the Secretary of State’s Office should have a base staff on hand to accept petitions. “I was a cop for 10 years. Bad weather was never an excuse for shutting down essential services such as first responders and hospital emergency rooms. Free and fair elections are at the core of a representative republic and are every bit as important. Do your job! “With a Tuesday deadline for submitting petitions, candidates who have planned ahead and worked hard are punished by Secretary Griswold’s decision. This creates a mad scramble to submit petitions on Monday, arbitrarily advantaging some candidates and disadvantaging others. “I call upon Jena Griswold to do the right thing and open her office tomorrow to allow the election process to move forward,” concluded Evans. The Evans campaign had an appointment to submit its petitions today at 12:30 p.m. and a back-up appointment for tomorrow at 12:30 p.m. Ninety percent of the campaign's signatures were collected by volunteers. Their hard work should be respected. Learn more about Gabe Evans’ campaign at [www.ElectGabeEvans.com](https://wayrap.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjYwMjExMCxcImxcIjoxMTU4MzEyMDY5ODcxNzExMDYsXCJyXCI6MTE1ODMxMjA3OTEzMDYzNTM5fSIsInMiOiI3ZWMwYWY0OGZkMzQ3Y2Y1In0). \- 30 -

Hi Friend,
Like millions of other Americans, I’m a parent thanks to in vitro fertilization (IVF).
Becoming a father changed me, and for the better. I believe it was God who granted me this chance to have a family. Now, I’m running for Congress to make sure that everyone has the same opportunity I did.
**If far-right extremists like my opponent, MAGA Congressman John Carter, have their way, families like mine will become a thing of the past.**[**If you agree that we need to defend against these anti-IVF extremists, please chip in $4 or more now. I will never allow folks like John Carter to take away our rights.**](https://whitlowforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4cf1793176d2a08f7e745bb54&id=f3ef81239a&e=b9b3f70fc1)

_Need to read more about how I’ll defend against Republicans in Congress who want to ban IVF nationwide? Read on..._
Trump’s allies in Congress — including my opponent, John Carter — are waging war on reproductive freedom.
They want to define human life as beginning at conception without any protection for IVF — a law that would not just ban abortion and several forms of birth control nationally, but would also subject all patients and doctors to crushing potential liability for IVF treatments.
| [](https://whitlowforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4cf1793176d2a08f7e745bb54&id=0bc6b5a36a&e=b9b3f70fc1)
---
_If extremists in Congress like John Carter succeed?_
**If MAGA Republicans retain control of the House in November, bills like their ‘Life at Conception’ Act will just keep coming.**
And just as we saw in Alabama this past month, hospitals, clinics, and doctors across the country will stop providing IVF treatments.
Practically overnight, the one in eight American couples who are affected by infertility would lose the option to have children through IVF. The 2% of U.S. births that result from IVF each year just wouldn’t happen. And millions of Americans would never experience the life-changing wonder that I had of becoming a parent.
[](https://whitlowforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4cf1793176d2a08f7e745bb54&id=3aedc156b0&e=b9b3f70fc1)
**This isn’t what the American people want.** But that won’t be enough to stop the MAGA agenda. It’s time we replaced folks like John Carter with people who take the word “Representatives” in “House of Representatives” more seriously.
[**That’s what I’m working to do. And anything you can contribute now will help me get one step closer to defeating John Carter in November.**](https://whitlowforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4cf1793176d2a08f7e745bb54&id=9541387299&e=b9b3f70fc1)

Happy Pi Day,
Derek — 3.14,
a day as good as any to share this tidbit about my time in Congress before
Donald Trump.

You see, I wasn’t always the partisan lightning rod Trump has made me out
to be.

Earlier in my career, I don’t think you could have found a member less
likely to be subjected to Fox News’ misinformation and smear machine (you
know, the one fined $787 million for lying about the election and Dominion
Voting Systems).

I co-founded the Democratic Study Group on National Security. I was a
frequent presence on Sunday morning shows not talking about Trump but
about foreign policy and intelligence matters. I spent far more time
securing federal dollars for light rail, an early earthquake warning
system, open space, and housing than I did conducting investigations. I
believed the only way to hold the seat I had flipped from red to blue in
the most expensive House race in the country in 2000 was by providing
exceptional constituent service and bringing resources back home to my
district.

But my prior experience as a federal prosecutor in the 1980s and 1990s
prepared me in ways I never could have anticipated to fight back against
Donald Trump — measured where he was erratic, truthful where he was
transgressive, methodical where he was maniacal.

It’s why I knew I could take on the fight when Speaker Pelosi asked my
committee to investigate Trump in a formal impeachment inquiry, how I
prosecuted his Senate trial, and how I helped lead the investigation of
the Capitol insurrection on the January 6 Committee.

I can’t wait to close this dark chapter of our history by defeating Donald
Trump once and for all this November, so Congress can return to some sense
of comity, and we deliver even more concrete results for California and
the American people than we did in the first two years of the Biden
Administration.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=mar2024_abs_em.YceVvx&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_MMG_AC90_20240314_PM3_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=5996%2E5257348%2EVpKDrr ]In order to do so, we have to hit our fundraising goal before
tomorrow’s final mid-month deadline of this FEC quarter. In a little over
2 weeks, our books will close on the last three months of fundraising, and
we’ll file a public report. Everyone from Donald Trump to Mitch McConnell
and their allies will be pouring resources into battleground states and
across the Senate map if our momentum falters. Can you chip in $3.14 for

| | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?
[YES](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zspca3nqh2bdhsrd1k79frn8nuumrh4idh2j6vjo_rp22sh2s8i6ep30c5ie6o74slh2bs) [NO](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zpk27b7h59839dd7u4rpk484ls0ehu0jk206a6jg_rp22sh2s8i6ep30c5ie6o74slh2bs) Even worse, progressives dismayed by recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put it in a _Boston Globe_ op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats."

What is your opinion about the Supreme Court's role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the proper role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** using this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z829fnidpkipj02ridg46snjdpilfa6cf55sklv8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30c5ie6o74slh2bs)**

And after you give your views, I hope you will consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The failure of too many of America's schools to provide young people with a proper education in American history and government makes it easier for progressives to **undermine** the separation of powers at the heart of limited government.

I'm sure you agree that too many Americans do not understand the role of an independent judiciary in preserving our constitutional order.

That's why Hillsdale College has expanded its educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly **reaching** and **teaching** millions of Americans in all 50 states--including yours!

These efforts counter the influence of anti-American ideology being taught in classrooms all across America.

Your support will help us to expand our educational outreach, including:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution" and "The U.S. Supreme Court."

* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty.

* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens, teachers, and students in K-12 schools across America.

* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by launching and providing ongoing guidance to over 70 classical K-12 charter schools nationwide that offer a strong American history and civics curriculum.

We **undertake our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty** --as we do all of our work--without accepting a penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

That means all of our work--including reaching and teaching millions about America's great heritage of liberty--depends entirely on the support of Americans like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

Please share your thoughts with Hillsdale using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court **right away--the link is below.

[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1l7ose6vijgjun40tg25vfr72j7h0334t5fi9d8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30c5ie6o74slh2bs)

Then please consider giving a generous tax-deductible gift to preserve liberty for future generations through education.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth - Defending Liberty since 1844

| | Dear Fellow American, “The Constitution is kind of trash.” That’s what a guest—with an Ivy League degree—said recently on a highly-rated daytime talk show. You’ve likely seen how “progressives” in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation’s principles of limited government and personal liberty with outrageous statements like “The Constitution is kind of trash.” And like that television pundit I mentioned, they are pushing a narrative that our Constitution is **flawed** , **outdated** , and **incapable** of dealing with the challenges of our time. Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution—Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison—gave you and me the perfect guide to understanding its timeless principles: _The Federalist Papers_.
---
| | Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described them as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” And these documents are just as relevant today as they were back then. If we’re serious about solving the current issues in our country, we shouldn’t run from them. We should embrace them. **That’s why I want to send you our entire 10-lesson course,["_The Federalist Papers_ ,"](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/4PKc37Oh8TiR5CjIcppOZg~~/AARclAA~/RgRn1rVIP0S-aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvaGlsbHNkYWxlL3N1cHBvcnQtZmVkZXJhbGlzdC1wYXBlcnM_c2M9MDA0NzBOMDI0MkwxNURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWZlZGVyYWxpc3RwYXBlcnNfZHZkJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PVBBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDMxNVcDc3BjQgpl7y4Z9GVAl6yRUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)****on DVD today when you make a tax-deductible donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**

# FRIDAY, MARCH 15, 2024
---|---
**Good Morning**! On this day in 2023, the very first edition of _The Flyover _landed in forty-seven inboxes. We made it to the one-year mark! The Editor can remember writing that first edition at the kitchen counter, wondering how far this little newsletter could go. Well, it went a _long way _in just one year, and we owe it all to you. We'll say more about this in a special message below, but we're truly thankful for your support. Thanks for making our first year great! If you haven't subscribed yet, you can do that here [with one click](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0D1P8zAQAOBfY2-tzuevZPDwSlWmt6yMke2ckwMnqVJTxL9HiJHuz_S8Xsdr5Mrb_BJXCq3sY8yNHzTqk7InNKORUyhESFpSUF6Bhd73IJeQSTnrirK5TFYlD7krZupTH1O23iTJAQENaGWhtw7N2XU5dhg7LMkjpCQM0MRtP85vO29toVK_9gcd57yvsoaltdtd6H8CB4HDXyJwuMaZ83_e3n-MHkjoy3T75Fr57rwwMK-R6691H20V-mJAHuG5ke1pwHcAAAD__38MW8I). ## Polls: Democrats Losing Black, Latino Support
New research shows that Democrats' longtime advantage with Black, Latino, and Asian-American voters has shrunk to its lowest point in more than 60 years. [Here's a look at the data trends.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLtuxCAQRb8Gd1gw4AcFRRp3mzalxWNYT4KNZZN19u-jTZ3mNlc6Rzoft_nmKNN2f3cr2prK7EKlB86Ky46DnnUTbUIEVA1aOUjRCTMY0Sw2JN8rHY0Oqk_OJOljjIMMGEbQRseGLAjQQslOmK4H3fZjcCO4EZIfQHjPtMBItRztZ6GtLpjyszzwaENZm2yXWveTqTcGE4Ppuq7W_VA5Xy-D6cVmMAnFYJKvuZYnj7iWcLh6cp9d-OILnbvbKPBHqcgP3L99puC25rBxvyhnOvuBaXFfHeU_bf03wm8AAAD__-ZKXeM) According to several polls, including Gallup and New York Times/Siena College, Black and Hispanic men may vote Republican in numbers not seen since President Dwight Eisenhower was elected in the 1950s. A Gallup survey last month showed that the Democratic Party's wide lead over the GOP in Black Americans' party preferences has shrunk by nearly 20 points over the past three years, with a similar decline among Hispanics. [Here's the survey results.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1urDAQQOGnMZ3RMBi8Llzchm5vmxIN_gEnA0bYu5u8fZTUqU9xpO_tPt8pcTrW_7QHW2OeydX0DHMvu0GimlXjbQwBQ98E2-kOBjDaQLNZck6DIVTGRRMDeBWxh7E35DrEDppkEVBB3w1ghhFVO94c3ZBuGBeNsCxCQfCp5qt9z-moW4j8lZ_hal3eG7ZbrWcR_T-Bk8DpCK_SrsT8OH-6wOnMzAKnEYzWo8DJhz27i2qRnEuQ65Ufh5cLk_uQWyonHclJ8g-upaVyfjaX9ecrMacyaqFg3Snx77v-KfEdAAD__5T9YA8) Analysts attribute the decline partly to a generational change, with younger voters of color being both more conservative and less tied to the Civil Rights-era preferences of their parents and grandparents.
## Starship Megarocket Hits Orbital Milestone
SpaceX's Starship megarocket, the largest and most powerful rocket ever built, [reached orbital speed ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLtu7SAQRb8Gd1jDGL8Kitu4O7dNaWEYDiT4ITM5Tv4-cup0W9rSWtJ6e8wPm3Lanv_tSobDPlvH6UVzI1UrUc-68iYQITUVGdUraGHsR6iiCWoc0bq-Gzz4QYcQYByU7kD5pu1pqZJBQA2NamFsO9R1Nzg7oB0wLD3CsggN5BPvZ_2-p40jhfy9v-is3b5W2UTmo4jmn8BJ4HRdV-22xd2nwOlGC5ygETipe5XDOvqShe1ZYjrkubsPYskxnV4yFZYhp2dkme3n5mIdec3VafxxpZxT6Xqh4bnalH_t_GeLnwAAAP__rlBfgA)for the first time in its third test flight, hitting new milestones in development. With hundreds watching, the rocket lifted off at 9:25 a.m. and quickly surpassed its previous distance mark. [You can see the launch here at the 40-second mark](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjz1vgzAQQH8NbEbHYWMzeOiSLV07In_GVzkB4Wto_33VzN2e9Ian93Fdr44qPW7v7p4s5211gemZ1kmMSqBcZR9tTgnT1Cc76hEULHqBvlij3Ah-CmNUkBc_Ba-ND4BG62hcnnuyCChhGhUsakY5zCY4g85g9hrB-05CisTbMXxu9OCScv3ZnukYwnbvqy3Me-umtw4vHV7O8xza7kL6sx1eXvwtGrujFdoFFzqi4NRY5Eq3wqK6r0co_WHjflKt1GbdSbjdHdVXgf_9_Q0AAP__y9lYRQ). The rocket is critical to NASA's plans to return astronauts to the moon later this decade. The rocket and its boosters broke up before splashing down in the Indian Ocean, but the test was considered a success. The two previous launches both exploded before completing their mission objectives.
## UFC Legend Saves Parents From Fire
Ultimate Fighting [legend Mark Coleman](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2unTAQhJ_GdD6y1wZMQZGG7qZNiRZY8Cb-QcY5KG8fcerbjT6NZkbz62v-Qg6cjp8Yaax7nnGt_KbZSN1KsLNttnEnAjINjbrXqlVDP6jGj8r1vVvBaGOUHRbnoIVuVVu3IekWqeERFFhldKuGtgP76tyKDtDBvvSglkVYRRvXXF6_M6fqaQ__8pvKa82xCaOv9byE-SFgEjDd9_2KEXc-fOV0PB4B09MgYDICJv0IsFopp3oBU8TyR645UMQkMVCpcimE1XM6ZE7S8yXzneSF74ecWCjVS_r89yK5cyHJUVZP0uN5Ml1VPkGcPuzOJWxNGbfz5hD46nph1RGRw2d8_fbK_wEAAP__HiN0zg) was hospitalized Tuesday after repeatedly entering a burning house to save his parents and their dog. The Ohio home shared by Coleman, 59, and his parents caught fire early Tuesday morning. Coleman awoke and got his parents out of the house, but the Rottweiler, Hammer, didn't survive. [The house burned down](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uhDAQhJ_GdEb2YvNTUKRxd2lTImPWxyaGPWHfoXv7iNTpRqORRt_3dZtunhLt90-_4VgiTz4UeuHUSG0lmMlUyxgRAZsKR91pZdXQDapax7nXi9ahQ4zDoi1obT2YdmgszjPqtqIRFBjVaKsG24Kp2z74HnwPce5AzbMwChcqfNTfTHtZMaY3v_CoA29VGtdSHlk0HwKcAHeeZ71QfvgS1msgwOXCx1uA2_HMAlzi4JMAd70KcKoR4PSVnjFIXollLr6g9Om5yc0fPzJwws3vcvalXBJk5EOulGWiiDJySnxe9crPjDLSgQJcB0M7WDBKdQJcdYzL46SUKLedMOq-eUp_AOVfnb8BAAD__77AdO8). Coleman suffered injuries related to smoke inhalation and was transported by helicopter to a Toledo hospital. He was intubated, but by Thursday, he could breathe on his own. In a video released Thursday, Coleman said he was grateful his parents were still alive and called himself, "[the happiest man in the world](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyhCAUQNGvwQ4HH6hQUKSh27QpHcSHkgXZQdTZv88kderb3Dlfj-lhQwz7-mkT6urzZF0NF06cdj0FMYlm0R4RkDeou7FjPVOjYs2mBzXPXnovpfL9oNBxz4bO8VmOQgrfN0EDA8F41zPVDyDaQTorwUrw8whsnolguISaS_udw1439PGdLyyty6mJeqv1dRD-QcAQMPd9t3i89t9IwKRkCZij5vImYCYCJiwEDFcj7zoxEjCndzTiivtCky1P6nLEZHcaT_d80-MsV7jCvtItnwdSHwo2RS-vO8QYjmEkgq3Jhvg3U_-l-QkAAP__yKpk8A)."

| Dear Flyover Reader, We made it! Exactly one year ago, the very first edition of **_The Flyover_** took flight. It landed in exactly 47 inboxes, and nearly all of them belonged to our friends and family. This morning, we sent _The Flyover to_ 622,745 readers! Here's what we've learned: First: **_We have the best readers in America_****.** You've told your friends about us, shared your feedback, voted in our polls, answered our trivia questions, clicked on our
stories and advertisers, and encouraged us along the way. Explosive growth like this doesn't just happen - you made it happen, and we're so thankful for your readership and support, truly. Second: **_This is a lot of fun._** I love coming to work and building something that people really want. We get to write about the entire news spectrum--deadly serious incidents, buried treasure, pictures of the galaxy, business, sports, and everything in between. I also hope that our joy and sincerity come through in our product: we're not just doing this to earn a living--we really like it. We have enormous respect for our readers, and I hope that's obvious when our edition lands in your inbox every morning. Third: **_Building an email newsletter isn 't easy._** In the early days of **_The Flyover,_** yours truly would often fall asleep on the couch while writing, then wake up in a panic at 5 AM, crank out the rest of the edition, and hit send. It's also difficult to get everything right. You surely notice when we make a mistake - and you let us know. Thank you! We are humble in our mistakes and work hard to get better every day.

We've been blown away at your support, and **_The Flyover_** can't possibly exist without it. We have big goals for the rest of 2024, and today I'm asking you to consider helping us make them happen. **Will you help us hire more staff, create more state-specific editions, expand to seven days a week (Sunday edition!), and make**** _The Flyover_****the best we possibly can by making a one-time, special anniversary donation today?** To be clear: **_The Flyover _**will always be FREE. | | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?
[YES](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d2b380964c61476fab69ca1ef15228c2&_e=F52qww7V4pHskxgRwEWHS7WCuMpqWHL2XYSMnm1LWNWz-q8iHF4h-erM0lQ0dyHkIHrRjON0-woieZb3zolDm7F-mRZoUGhMtkWMQ9pWKFNPghzUwj_DjSvcGno_LYFoBDFRho-UEImIx7wKEySi9ZCla5lNR7699_2Fr75TbNSi7BWzwT7fD9KwmUJPrxwg_nFqnETTid7H91VreyBlz5K4AnCnRU1i8RJon-QF6V96cmbUkBgtkhVsgXQsC7SKWHPbatXq7ek0CxNKDmKnhAy7gr611nK1jIDM0RNHDN8qtXNTZnpMKPazfEOGjXIpgRKQsmFxQQEvzRQojaugFG6DjP6qeEcWllwtUxq0KeN89Xk5__L_KoaMeEv7sKbUQ80CbdyldD-3-11-_ArkAg%3D%3D) [NO](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d2b380964c61476fab69ca1ef15228c2&_e=F52qww7V4pHskxgRwEWHS7WCuMpqWHL2XYSMnm1LWNWz-q8iHF4h-erM0lQ0dyHkIHrRjON0-woieZb3zolDm7F-mRZoUGhMtkWMQ9pWKFNPghzUwj_DjSvcGno_LYFoBDFRho-UEImIx7wKEySi9ZCla5lNR7699_2Fr75TbNSi7BWzwT7fD9KwmUJPrxwg_nFqnETTid7H91VreyBlz5K4AnCnRU1i8RJon-QF6V96cmbUkBgtkhVsgXQsC7SKoagX7yKVYhj_Op15B4UAjGA9d8cXXqDgGZVP3TvJRiK1cU_umPpPF5xMBaRAdP6NwY3mxDsi8JEAWuY8ptNnYfk5sKHYmQW21fRAj17q-2lpPeNweaiDDdcpQUnvrFt_qaPu5W_-uDynY1T9S-07gA%3D%3D) Even worse, progressives dismayed by recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put it in a _Boston Globe_ op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats."

What is your opinion about the Supreme Court's role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the proper role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** using this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d2b380964c61476fab69ca1ef15228c2&_e=F52qww7V4pHskxgRwEWHS7WCuMpqWHL2XYSMnm1LWNWz-q8iHF4h-erM0lQ0dyHkIHrRjON0-woieZb3zolDm7F-mRZoUGhMtkWMQ9pWKFNPghzUwj_DjSvcGno_LYFoBDFRho-UEImIx7wKEySi9ZCla5lNR7699_2Fr75TbNSi7BWzwT7fD9KwmUJPrxwg_nFqnETTid7H91VreyBlz5K4AnCnRU1i8RJon-QF6V96cmbUkBgtkhVsgXQsC7SK5VxG8XMdG53_fmlLLShUReE87MQFbqjcvKdUVVeDy1EC6MY2tf-nIhyqx-aRdClLOp0a6Wl-0TNAl9CcKVizkLd3UkW-cahPJB26VyQobk6THE28iwc9lQSy1Qxl9uudQBK5kvtg2I3CG4DeV63T7A%3D%3D)**

And after you give your views, I hope you will consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The failure of too many of America's schools to provide young people with a proper education in American history and government makes it easier for progressives to **undermine** the separation of powers at the heart of limited government.

I'm sure you agree that too many Americans do not understand the role of an independent judiciary in preserving our constitutional order.

That's why Hillsdale College has expanded its educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly **reaching** and **teaching** millions of Americans in all 50 states--including yours!

These efforts counter the influence of anti-American ideology being taught in classrooms all across America.

Your support will help us to expand our educational outreach, including:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution" and "The U.S. Supreme Court."

* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty.

* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens, teachers, and students in K-12 schools across America.

* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by launching and providing ongoing guidance to over 70 classical K-12 charter schools nationwide that offer a strong American history and civics curriculum.

We **undertake our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty** --as we do all of our work--without accepting a penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

That means all of our work--including reaching and teaching millions about America's great heritage of liberty--depends entirely on the support of Americans like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

Please share your thoughts with Hillsdale using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court **right away--the link is below.

[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d2b380964c61476fab69ca1ef15228c2&_e=F52qww7V4pHskxgRwEWHS7WCuMpqWHL2XYSMnm1LWNWz-q8iHF4h-erM0lQ0dyHkIHrRjON0-woieZb3zolDm7F-mRZoUGhMtkWMQ9pWKFNPghzUwj_DjSvcGno_LYFoBDFRho-UEImIx7wKEySi9ZCla5lNR7699_2Fr75TbNSi7BWzwT7fD9KwmUJPrxwg_nFqnETTid7H91VreyBlz5K4AnCnRU1i8RJon-QF6V96cmbUkBgtkhVsgXQsC7SKFZ6hy_1MLRXmETm0kzm8ThA9GUNkpfej-5mHOSZSosrBQKFIWsRSdRXzn9E8MA0LyM8-KAAXB3AUKZKmG0QI2UelAqFS960zqLYm3pu7V9EgUuVjVRsd3ARyjLChiQDARXh1UUAS7g9auStFjue7VQ%3D%3D)

Then please consider giving a generous tax-deductible gift to preserve liberty for future generations through education.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

name: Conservatives Give
subject: How do you see the Supreme Court?
body:
Your participation in Hillsdale College's National Survey on the United States Supreme Court is requested.

| | |
---
| This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College | [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3d28f10b99e6470dab9d1fbfed015b56&_e=PedWPe0TnjJgyU5DUSUiDo8z-Oq5NKXIcuEjCU5Bafil7gmb0yITR5ckp3Nb3NkARSrtc1siwMncBgEjZAVXsf75LInJ1XL1kxxObyNBNrUoeF8g94bAdh_We7ratLEWJvA5ypsvcySyURyH19EA27uLo_Kj74FWnY2qwhWzlZ97MOfU5-byqX_eTsoBGGgv_Ye9OnvmodyswLw6IR6u9EB4aK62XRSyWgmIEQm7pDyipE-_yP8b3oCLs99eL_AW55tEvb4OUoWtP_ITyD8ZoCnfLwsHm5t_uED_WvTDPSgW7j0pmZYr9Szp0xcwoeJsovQmygGUcAB1DV6zD0Q_FG4tNsoxHlcX73WWd7IPRJuqClfdbVQ8E9JcS0oHp8M5Wn6NeTgd1T1zCz1CHrrPeQ%3D%3D)
---
| | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?
[YES](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3d28f10b99e6470dab9d1fbfed015b56&_e=PedWPe0TnjJgyU5DUSUiDo8z-Oq5NKXIcuEjCU5Bafil7gmb0yITR5ckp3Nb3NkARSrtc1siwMncBgEjZAVXsf75LInJ1XL1kxxObyNBNrUoeF8g94bAdh_We7ratLEWJvA5ypsvcySyURyH19EA27uLo_Kj74FWnY2qwhWzlZ97MOfU5-byqX_eTsoBGGgv_Ye9OnvmodyswLw6IR6u9EB4aK62XRSyWgmIEQm7pDyipE-_yP8b3oCLs99eL_AWlQ8_HJxMIsBuz2X8EIO1nLXJ7asH-iKW94Pds9Ooku0TmTxmxVEFg_a1DC4kFIKzI_VrNZV-ExGXDKyDyYAcj8xCVnO9tsrpQeFUC03v3oNv0DMWFAT2qyzkJDTa6tFbfmUz7iVUYzxFHXjdFfnnZA%3D%3D) [NO](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3d28f10b99e6470dab9d1fbfed015b56&_e=PedWPe0TnjJgyU5DUSUiDo8z-Oq5NKXIcuEjCU5Bafil7gmb0yITR5ckp3Nb3NkARSrtc1siwMncBgEjZAVXsf75LInJ1XL1kxxObyNBNrUoeF8g94bAdh_We7ratLEWJvA5ypsvcySyURyH19EA27uLo_Kj74FWnY2qwhWzlZ97MOfU5-byqX_eTsoBGGgv_Ye9OnvmodyswLw6IR6u9EB4aK62XRSyWgmIEQm7pDyipE-_yP8b3oCLs99eL_AWbAlWxnnq-7hcTq38RbK1g_1A2WDO9lzU5Z9vG6-q38MThn4Bwn2Uhu9TSU0kkpJ3KxUvAmsuLZRJL2Y0TSihGWykAl8LVcL4FQ7t73_q4tx8MCOWkAmAOw5JvlFBPLwPQ_AQUc338BIuAtPuKbyYsg%3D%3D) Even worse, progressives dismayed by recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put it in a _Boston Globe_ op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats."

What is your opinion about the Supreme Court's role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the proper role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** using this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3d28f10b99e6470dab9d1fbfed015b56&_e=PedWPe0TnjJgyU5DUSUiDo8z-Oq5NKXIcuEjCU5Bafil7gmb0yITR5ckp3Nb3NkARSrtc1siwMncBgEjZAVXsf75LInJ1XL1kxxObyNBNrUoeF8g94bAdh_We7ratLEWJvA5ypsvcySyURyH19EA27uLo_Kj74FWnY2qwhWzlZ97MOfU5-byqX_eTsoBGGgv_Ye9OnvmodyswLw6IR6u9EB4aK62XRSyWgmIEQm7pDyipE-_yP8b3oCLs99eL_AWaK0nlAxpeRJRPtyaSlV1pb-A1l3K7gh_u508m5xjNK77ZYCuZ7RhtcxbNU1DRBiZTg-Pv4FQM_s66ZVjygF17DDqGvkJIaC-q9wyXrGM74Sm2UyyEdHHiM0AoKB_hX-3cgS1Djrne3BjBJ9QscFdjw%3D%3D)**

And after you give your views, I hope you will consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The failure of too many of America's schools to provide young people with a proper education in American history and government makes it easier for progressives to **undermine** the separation of powers at the heart of limited government.

I'm sure you agree that too many Americans do not understand the role of an independent judiciary in preserving our constitutional order.

That's why Hillsdale College has expanded its educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly **reaching** and **teaching** millions of Americans in all 50 states--including yours!

These efforts counter the influence of anti-American ideology being taught in classrooms all across America.

Your support will help us to expand our educational outreach, including:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution" and "The U.S. Supreme Court."

* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty.

* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens, teachers, and students in K-12 schools across America.

* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by launching and providing ongoing guidance to over 70 classical K-12 charter schools nationwide that offer a strong American history and civics curriculum.

We **undertake our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty** --as we do all of our work--without accepting a penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

That means all of our work--including reaching and teaching millions about America's great heritage of liberty--depends entirely on the support of Americans like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

Please share your thoughts with Hillsdale using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court **right away--the link is below.

[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3d28f10b99e6470dab9d1fbfed015b56&_e=PedWPe0TnjJgyU5DUSUiDo8z-Oq5NKXIcuEjCU5Bafil7gmb0yITR5ckp3Nb3NkARSrtc1siwMncBgEjZAVXsf75LInJ1XL1kxxObyNBNrUoeF8g94bAdh_We7ratLEWJvA5ypsvcySyURyH19EA27uLo_Kj74FWnY2qwhWzlZ97MOfU5-byqX_eTsoBGGgv_Ye9OnvmodyswLw6IR6u9EB4aK62XRSyWgmIEQm7pDyipE-_yP8b3oCLs99eL_AWrvMlgXKLwp-4T1cQlEPCe1G3YasIMlSi1AcLZwiYIik_4b_bmDk2EJgDkIXN3kJmtcAjA1EXf_V2Ie9yuxC97ubjopCdT3K_v4ZM8bV707kgsHQi6gOLraT0OMz-0IAC2rPv6uz0PgRBdSncIQLhGg%3D%3D)

Then please consider giving a generous tax-deductible gift to preserve liberty for future generations through education.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth - Defending Liberty since 1844

| | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?
[YES](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fe3f0de7208243d9b78e205454951f63&_e=-CdTQMzHEVNGnYhjfDol6JjTaXyQqncAfI3EYU8Qnm2DW-ONZ3ai0N1EmG-i9Rx1UXAwCe7yFQeeHNX92871k7IE7X-fKVoTdU3oC5yojZCysT9JT5x9rIZTQRaxvbpNwDir_yXxyHYbuCANTU2Ic2dLi2sCa7wRx5E7_H34G8laoigRBqNLYcmo91erk6Bf8vObUMxJkvGjDpGpsGkpBfmoFyTbkrwbvUOg1ua3xpyX0TZzdKODCXoMeiENnCTjMR7TTQ3KaPF5gHRcB3FVcVgyea3Fvb6MHWrATTye5e0C4yWLInWguv13nBFMp9xN0xFD0qXoK6D0rhuchyLzCq9cJblqVQ6mEpVHR23f2PFRzOR7f5pne3i7w4q1j6kwrxieNEbOzTNdkdQenkCuxA%3D%3D) [NO](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fe3f0de7208243d9b78e205454951f63&_e=-CdTQMzHEVNGnYhjfDol6JjTaXyQqncAfI3EYU8Qnm2DW-ONZ3ai0N1EmG-i9Rx1UXAwCe7yFQeeHNX92871k7IE7X-fKVoTdU3oC5yojZCysT9JT5x9rIZTQRaxvbpNwDir_yXxyHYbuCANTU2Ic2dLi2sCa7wRx5E7_H34G8laoigRBqNLYcmo91erk6Bf8vObUMxJkvGjDpGpsGkpBfmoFyTbkrwbvUOg1ua3xpyX0TZzdKODCXoMeiENnCTj-PHqXkt2Q2E85FJ6eHttBa04Q_5Emj7lLPDrwLhjsFhFbEMobMofPznWN8NJusDa_fSlyhJQeYNny1Qz6eRtnz6UWe2JmANzNuy0nZMBBF2bNH83hIr3ntEecUBdbOLTAIPm2KSeTiKWD2UjFNUnRw%3D%3D) Even worse, progressives dismayed by recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put it in a _Boston Globe_ op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats."

What is your opinion about the Supreme Court's role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the proper role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** using this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fe3f0de7208243d9b78e205454951f63&_e=-CdTQMzHEVNGnYhjfDol6JjTaXyQqncAfI3EYU8Qnm2DW-ONZ3ai0N1EmG-i9Rx1UXAwCe7yFQeeHNX92871k7IE7X-fKVoTdU3oC5yojZCysT9JT5x9rIZTQRaxvbpNwDir_yXxyHYbuCANTU2Ic2dLi2sCa7wRx5E7_H34G8laoigRBqNLYcmo91erk6Bf8vObUMxJkvGjDpGpsGkpBfmoFyTbkrwbvUOg1ua3xpyX0TZzdKODCXoMeiENnCTjkelvMocuAKryKomOqfBiaojDUwELcGUkGfZUymIwGZ1kP9fd3Ij9jGenYpa3LmPWnm98nqhmsavfCoSn4WFDjaHu-6yyhWQEoqXGjzFXcfGSIC4kV_MPTeVx1pZhEtHiTYQPIvdkytK1Lw3cDreg9Q%3D%3D)**

And after you give your views, I hope you will consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The failure of too many of America's schools to provide young people with a proper education in American history and government makes it easier for progressives to **undermine** the separation of powers at the heart of limited government.

I'm sure you agree that too many Americans do not understand the role of an independent judiciary in preserving our constitutional order.

That's why Hillsdale College has expanded its educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly **reaching** and **teaching** millions of Americans in all 50 states--including yours!

These efforts counter the influence of anti-American ideology being taught in classrooms all across America.

Your support will help us to expand our educational outreach, including:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution" and "The U.S. Supreme Court."

* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty.

* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens, teachers, and students in K-12 schools across America.

* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by launching and providing ongoing guidance to over 70 classical K-12 charter schools nationwide that offer a strong American history and civics curriculum.

We **undertake our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty** --as we do all of our work--without accepting a penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

That means all of our work--including reaching and teaching millions about America's great heritage of liberty--depends entirely on the support of Americans like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

Please share your thoughts with Hillsdale using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court **right away--the link is below.

[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey**](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fe3f0de7208243d9b78e205454951f63&_e=-CdTQMzHEVNGnYhjfDol6JjTaXyQqncAfI3EYU8Qnm2DW-ONZ3ai0N1EmG-i9Rx1UXAwCe7yFQeeHNX92871k7IE7X-fKVoTdU3oC5yojZCysT9JT5x9rIZTQRaxvbpNwDir_yXxyHYbuCANTU2Ic2dLi2sCa7wRx5E7_H34G8laoigRBqNLYcmo91erk6Bf8vObUMxJkvGjDpGpsGkpBfmoFyTbkrwbvUOg1ua3xpyX0TZzdKODCXoMeiENnCTjbPlIT0E-Pxr7S-G3t_8Gi_FKkT_3z1-WUKnNSWp0Tvzt4swqusCwPyU2nrD55yiAD4HMMKp0KoJmHKVfhg8uEu_3RenhLUuOTGgTQvrGkyQ4DbBzWd_ba1MIE3Zrf0fHNlmWu1khBPvp3sSpdMRt6Q%3D%3D)

Then please consider giving a generous tax-deductible gift to preserve liberty for future generations through education.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

| | | In his State of the Union speech, President Biden called for billionaires to finally pay their fair share in taxes. **The richest .01% of Americans pay only around 8% in taxes, far less than the average American pays. Biden proposed taxing billionaires 25%, which would raise over $440 billion over the next decade. ** This is a completely reasonable plan and we fully support it – but it's getting a lot of pushback from Republicans who are in those billionaires' pockets. We need to show that Biden's plan has strong support. President Biden said it best: "No billionaire should pay a lower federal tax rate than a teacher, a sanitation worker or a nurse." body:
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/80986806/461050310/-749972717?amount=3&refcode=UTS_FR_90DC_240315_2_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg5NDc2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjYwNTdkMTlmLWMwZTItZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=UkJN7R3nxcvsYKOqD0s3QUVkeQVxrM9aSb4MYHMQ6z4=)
This is going to be a long email about our January 6th trauma.
[_**If you’re not ready to talk about it or don’t have time to read the whole email, I understand. But if you could still chip in a split donation between my campaign and Upset the Setup to help me jumpstart this race, I’d appreciate it >>**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/80986807/461050311/-749972717?amount=10&refcode=UTS_FR_90DC_240315_2_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg5NDc2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjYwNTdkMTlmLWMwZTItZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=UkJN7R3nxcvsYKOqD0s3QUVkeQVxrM9aSb4MYHMQ6z4=)
If you’re still reading this, I’m assuming you’re ready. Let’s talk about our trauma. You and me.
Ask yourself, what has our nation been arguing about for the last 3 years? What conversation has been dominating the media, the government, occupying our courts, and our daily conversations? And even separating friends and families?
**January 6, 2021.**
The ripples from that day still threaten our democracy. The lives of election workers – the backbone of our electoral systems – are being threatened online via hundreds of messages on Facebook, Twitter and Instagram by those who would disrupt our elections:
_**“Watch your back.” “I know where you sleep.” “Be afraid.”**_
Because I speak out about these challenges to our democracy, I get the same threatening messages. “We know where you live.”
_Yet MAGA representatives in Congress continue to claim our elections are being rigged. _
The only difference between your January 6th trauma and mine is where we were when we experienced it.
I was at the Capitol immersed in a profane mix of sweat, screams, shrieks, anger, fear, blood, death, broken limbs, spit, hatred, horror, racism, bigotry, and heroism.
Capitol and Washington Police officers fought for our lives, the lives of fellow police officers, and the nation's elected leaders – it didn’t matter if they were a Republican, Democrat or an Independent. They were the men and women we sent to Washington to govern our nation.

We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. That’s why we need to urgently reach out to top supporters like you for help: = We can't tell you enough how integral your support is to this campaign, friend. These benchmarks aren't arbitrary. We carefully calculate what we need to raise to plan ahead for our ad reservations, voter outreach, and digital content. So it's really important that we stay on pace to reach tomorrow's midnight deadline. Can you please click this link right now to make a donation to support Democrats and help me keep Nevada blue? = Thank you in advance. – Jacky | | = A note from Sen. # ▶️: 5 Ways to Know...

Peter- being an average American comes with its share of challenges.
[**I encourage you to watch the video below to understand five of the many challenges faced by ordinary Americans like you and me:**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=d1eaad99b0&e=a2a46ff12c)
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=55c02bc72b&e=a2a46ff12c)

**Are you wondering if you're one of us, the common folk? Here are five ways to determine if you are:**
1. You're concerned about working until you're well into your 90s because you have little to no money saved for retirement.

2. The cost of living continues to rise, and your wages can't keep up.

3. Your children are facing a tougher path than you did in affording a home or attending college.

4. Taking time off work or seeking medical care feels like an unaffordable luxury.

5. If you feel your freedoms are being stripped away - whether it's women's bodily autonomy, voters' rights, social security, or public education.

**Let's face it, the system isn't designed for us, the common people.**
I am one of us, a common person, and I'm determined to go to Washington to work for us.
**Let's unite, amplify our voices, and strive for solutions that serve us all.**

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE****CONTACT:**[Chris Gustafson](mailto:chris@rogersforsenate.com "chris@rogersforsenate.com") **Op-Ed: Rogers: U.S. can no longer take China threat lightly****
**
---
In case you missed it, Republican candidate for U.S. Senate Mike Rogers [penned an op-ed in the _Detroit News_](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=7f4ff115021341b79f33744ac41d3845&_e=Ln0utQIRAxxWH4hcjygJYHX_X7xoQlO8wgi5JqBd6BwkhX1Wt5r0-JZGPOFA_zDBiAZFXEBOtPRxKGTVNXe_XVYkxrnPMV_b0xp5l2OmkGGZfLB5tAs7v9VrQU25CEPWsvRUjX0qfXPajsA7HFp9XnXQkBIFWvtluw4kb_rZ0QvY2TE__Sa4T_e1LrVDg_8n6vEybmmUrll7lNyB-nnZc-RPTy9uGXHqwDdCJMZ3KOqcTAnC6fxh01L4MrsiBjFjwYrOZx5HJyr1ACpZVTppChaOdbvvHW9GNpEQTbfB_O8WGYJdEKiqfr0FDV6pN_zS) highlighting the clear and present danger that China and the businesses under its control present to the American people. Mike [previously wrote an op-ed](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=7f4ff115021341b79f33744ac41d3845&_e=Ln0utQIRAxxWH4hcjygJYFUVjoRG1olexukFuYGcGihnHk4i-EFOROC9vJBQbHESvOukicFf-D5JdWFwKbri9EDyMf21UKwV06dFwN3gBH5PJIhGqkiSJptnqhZkyjoJf5G5wubhJ1YAkV3Sto8Eld22JQrscey8gkOcmLjN8YM1OZpJ7pN_wA5kv2CadGtp8ch76pUwdBjWZTX_UV4C95A8cf5aEDvKbznxrWBN86m1yeA3-8xEa56OBmEYJUFjaXD0BrdU1pWhweT98mXftXBzYEgXZAcv1mu3myYhYRE%3D) in _The Messenger_ about China's efforts to undermine the U.S. and take its place as the global economic leader. **Rogers: U.S. can no longer take China threat lightly**[Detroit News](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=7f4ff115021341b79f33744ac41d3845&_e=Ln0utQIRAxxWH4hcjygJYHX_X7xoQlO8wgi5JqBd6BwkhX1Wt5r0-JZGPOFA_zDBiAZFXEBOtPRxKGTVNXe_XVYkxrnPMV_b0xp5l2OmkGGZfLB5tAs7v9VrQU25CEPWsvRUjX0qfXPajsA7HFp9XnXQkBIFWvtluw4kb_rZ0QtY1Qo7kx1akNV5dUBUQ2Iw4GNOld-s3VtrLUIpt8ReMcAzwI1RJVHsiDAPFk0zBUHX2UtOQjCnjz4tJ0YpyVB8X6zAiJWV_l_Eiju6LMtefDXyJXysj2fZvsQ-XcO1J-Aa3wQrzK-apFKLLVMnTt7v) March 15, 2024 _Congress took a big step forward in America’s contest with the Chinese Communist Party this week, as the House of Representatives passed legislation that requires TikTok to sever its relationship with its Chinese parent, ByteDance, or shut down in the United States entirely.

The fact that there is controversy around this shows you how little most Americans understand about the threat we face from China.

“It’s just a social media app,” they claim. “How bad could it be?”_ _Well, for starters TikTok collects untold amounts of data from its users phones. Under China law, companies are obligated to work with the CCP, which means your data could end up in the hands of Beijing.
**
**__The thing about Chinese influence activity is that no one thinks it is a big issue until it is, and I’ve experienced this firsthand. As chairman of the House Intelligence Committee, I oversaw the drafting of the first comprehensive investigation into the activities of Huawei and ZTE, two massive Chinese telecommunication companies. The committee found that these companies represented a clear and present danger to our country’s economic and national security, were attempting to penetrate and control the rollout of our 5G networks, were engaged in comprehensive intellectual theft, and were violating sanctions. They were, quite simply, working on behalf of the CCP’s interests.

I took the committee’s report on the road attempting to raise awareness at what these companies were doing and what they represented. Many were dismissive of the threat. It took some time, but American and international businesses finally came around to the conclusions the committee drew about Huawei and ZTE, but also about Chinese business practices.

My work didn’t stop in Congress. I’ve spent my time since encouraging American companies to remove Chinese equipment from their networks.

Raising awareness wasn’t enough, though. The 5G space was overwhelmingly dominated by China, so we encouraged American and allied companies to step up their efforts and become more competitive. We needed to take actions to prevent these Chinese companies from getting contracts to build out our 5G networks. We needed to aggressively look at other Chinese investment and acquisition efforts to ensure American innovation stayed in American hands._ _For as much as we’re recognizing the threat from China, we’re undermining our efforts to counter their influence and reach. We’re handing the keys to our economic future over to Beijing with ill-thought-out electric vehicle mandates that only increase our reliance on Chinese supply chains.

It’s madness.

For too long we’ve taken the threat for granted, but it’s finally dawned on Americans that China doesn’t have our best interests in mind._ _From EV mandates that favor China to social media platforms that allow the CCP access to every American, now is the time to act smartly and sensibly, countering Beijing where they advance, undermining their efforts where possible and ensuring that American industry and businesses have a leg up._
[Continue reading at the _Detroit News_](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=7f4ff115021341b79f33744ac41d3845&_e=Ln0utQIRAxxWH4hcjygJYHX_X7xoQlO8wgi5JqBd6BwkhX1Wt5r0-JZGPOFA_zDBiAZFXEBOtPRxKGTVNXe_XVYkxrnPMV_b0xp5l2OmkGGZfLB5tAs7v9VrQU25CEPWsvRUjX0qfXPajsA7HFp9XnXQkBIFWvtluw4kb_rZ0QsCIFSjwc-2BcKnC8V6DpOFwvQtaf8TLT7Lsg5l5Q-GdsEe9pGF7w2I_WMHjGusWWs53_uofGQ1-Q79_CMcVKwxHxcI54VpyMWVsNW8p8D2_Q7iNbcJMWL2UWpo5o0ZqupeZYnm4P3bpwqKcApou48G). Learn more about Mike Rogers and his plan to get America Back on Track at [RogersForSenate.com](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=7f4ff115021341b79f33744ac41d3845&_e=Ln0utQIRAxxWH4hcjygJYFUVjoRG1olexukFuYGcGihoVX78ITUHBsPebrHAo_qN3PZPj1EwEcDRIlTZIj-aZ9TcFce5sy-Kl1IZ-o0NkuwUotQuXjRCNHUwesSguzij1W52h8E4u82FfVv1BPZTqUVdMMDnoRMelMNqEE8hsPHc9iej_S5560N-9tj1oZDVG0J6uQX8tKAmf8ClOfvuXw%3D%3D).

MEDIA CONTACT
Robert Vane
robert@veteranstrategies.com
Suzanne Crouch’s Latest Commercial Shows Commitment to Tackling the Mental Health Crisis

Three in Ten Indiana High School Students have considered suicide.
https://vimeo.com/923581936?share=copy&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8b8029d150-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_39_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-e619a8bcad-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Indianapolis, IND — Republican gubernatorial candidate Suzanne Crouch has launched a new broadcast television advertisement (https://vimeo.com/923581936?share=copy&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8b8029d150-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_39_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-e619a8bcad-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) in which she addresses the mental health crisis in Indiana, pledging resources for people battling depression and to combat teen suicide.

“Three in ten (https://iyi.org/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8b8029d150-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_39_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-e619a8bcad-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) Indiana high school students have considered committing suicide,” said Crouch. “I lost my sister Nancy to suicide and know how devastating this tragic loss is to families. As governor, I will work to end our state’s mental health crisis.”

"Suzanne is a dedicated champion of our most vulnerable Hoosiers. I️ know she will continue to be so as governor, and that's why he has my unreserved endorsement," said Fishers City Council President Cecilia Coble.

“As governor, I will do all I can to prevent families from experiencing the pain and helplessness of suicide,” said Crouch. “We will ensure Hoosiers have access to affordable mental health care.”

Crouch’s previous broadcast spot, “A Time for Strength (https://app.frame.io/presentations/6e2286d9-1218-4ecd-9c6a-19dc4d722286?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8b8029d150-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_39_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-e619a8bcad-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) ”, highlights her personal story of family members who have struggled with addiction and the importance of getting treatment.

Since its launch in December 2022, the Crouch for Governor campaign has received public pledges of support from more than 100 grassroots leaders—including more than 20 past or present county sheriffs.

Additionally, Suzanne is the only candidate in the race for governor who has committed to eliminating Indiana’s individual income tax. As a result of her plan, the average Hoosier would save $2,000 annually in state taxes.

You can learn more about “Axe the Tax” here (https://crouchforindiana.com/axe-the-tax/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8b8029d150-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_39_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-e619a8bcad-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

If you or someone you know is contemplating suicide, please contact Indiana Suicide Prevention services at https://www.in.gov/issp/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=8b8029d150-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_14_03_39_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-e619a8bcad-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D or just dial 988.

###

To learn more about how Suzanne is the only conservative Republican fighting China, proposing an elimination of Indiana’s individual income tax, and casting the key votes to protect our most vulnerable Hoosiers, please visit her web site at www.crouchforindiana.com.

[**Will you rush a contribution to GIFFORDS PAC today before our mid-month deadline passes? I wouldn’t reach out personally if this weren’t so important.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-mar24.5Zicua&refcode=em240315-1-30&t=2&akid=7766%2E3935704%2EuD9qr2)

body:
With the 2024 elections approaching fast, we just rolled out our newest slate of endorsements!
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240315-1&t=1&akid=458%2E587540%2ECUwQXl)
Peter, have you seen this yet?
Last year we were proud to elect our first endorsed candidate, Nadarius Clark, to the Virginia Assembly. But that race was just the beginning — and with the 2024 elections approaching fast, we just rolled out our newest slate of endorsements!
We’re endorsing **Sarah McBride** for U.S. Congress in Delaware, **Christine Cockley** for the Ohio House, **Bryce Berry** for the Georgia House, **Ashwin Ramaswami** for the Georgia Senate, **Anna Thomas** for the Pennsylvania House, and **Anja Wookey-Huffman** for the Montana House of Representatives.
**[Pitch in $5 to help us elect all of them this November!](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240315-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240315-1-458&refcode2=458_587540_CUwQXl&akid=458%2E587540%2ECUwQXl)**
These young leaders are exactly the type of folks we need in office if we’re ever going to make progress on the issues affecting young people most — like climate change, gun violence, the skyrocketing cost of living, and more.
**[Make sure to read more about them in David's message below, and then pitch in $5 or anything you can to help us support their campaigns. As a grassroots funded organization, we can't do it without you!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240315-1?refcode=em20240315-1&amount=5&refcode2=458_587540_CUwQXl&akid=458%2E587540%2ECUwQXl)
— The team at Leaders We Deserve
_\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: David Hogg [info@e.leaderswedeserve.com]
Date: Weds, Mar 13, 2024 at 3:13 PM
Subject: Announcing our first slate of 2024 endorsements
To: Peter [dpwillis67@gmail.com]_
Peter,
In November, we elected our first endorsed candidate when Nadarius Clark won his election to the Virginia Assembly. But like we said then, that race was not the finish line. Our work electing the next generation of leaders is just getting started.
Today, we're super excited to reveal our first slate of 2024 endorsed candidates! [**But first, can you rush $5 to elect these bold new leaders in November?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240315-1?refcode=em20240315-1&amount=5&refcode2=458_587540_CUwQXl&akid=458%2E587540%2ECUwQXl)
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240315-1?refcode=em20240315-1&amount=5&refcode2=458_587540_CUwQXl&akid=458%2E587540%2ECUwQXl)
**Sarah McBride (U.S. Congress — Delaware, At Large)** Sarah McBride has been a results-driven, powerhouse lawmaker in the Delaware State Senate. She passed paid family and medical leave, which was the largest expansion of Delaware’s social safety net in decades. If she wins this race in November, she would be the first trans woman elected to the U.S. Congress.
**Christine Cockley (OH HD-6 – Columbus)** Christine Cockley has spent the last several years doing racial justice work in Columbus. Her campaign is focused on health care, gun violence prevention, raising the minimum wage, and other crucial issues for her community. If elected, Christine would be the second Jewish woman elected to the Ohio House.
**Bryce Berry (GA HD-56 – Atlanta)** Bryce Berry is a middle school Algebra teacher in the Atlanta public school system. He is running for the Georgia legislature to bring positive change to his community. In his campaign, Bryce is fighting for economic development, education, health care, affordable housing, and solutions to rampant gun violence.
**Ashwin Ramaswami (GA SD-48 – Atlanta)** Ashwin Ramaswami is a second-generation Indian-American immigrant who built his career in software engineering, election security, and policy research. He is taking on Republican incumbent Rep. Shawn Still, one of the fake electors who attempted to award Georgia’s electoral votes to Donald Trump instead of Joe Biden. This is one of the most flippable seats in the Georgia Senate.
**Anna Thomas (PA HD-137 – South Central PA)** Anna Thomas is a former school board member and education advocate who is running for one of the most flippable seats in the Pennsylvania House this cycle. Anna lost this seat in the last election by only 703 votes. Winning this seat is critical to holding Democrats' two-seat majority in the Pennsylvania House.
**Anja Wookey-Huffman (MT HD-65 – Bozeman)** Anja Wookey-Huffman is a working class candidate and organizer who would be a vocal force against Montana’s MAGA movement in the statehouse. She’s ready to fight for abortion rights and take on those who stand in the way of more affordable housing who have made life hard for underserved communities and women and have priced out working class Montanans.
[**I am personally setting a $24,000 fundraising goal to build a strong foundation of support for our 2024 Leaders We Deserve candidates. If you’re as pumped about these badass progressive changemakers as I am, pitch in $5 now.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240315-1?refcode=em20240315-1&amount=5&refcode2=458_587540_CUwQXl&akid=458%2E587540%2ECUwQXl)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240315-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240315-1-458&refcode2=458_587540_CUwQXl&akid=458%2E587540%2ECUwQXl)**
We’ll be in touch soon with more information about our endorsed candidates and we’ll keep you updated about their races from now until November. We’re going to pour everything we can into electing these young leaders all across the country.
This is exactly why Kevin and I founded Leaders We Deserve — because there are young people rising up to run for office and claim their power. But they will need a strong foundation of support to break down barriers and win these pivotal races.
[**Supporting these candidates is going to take a lot of resources. That's why reaching our $24,000 goal this week is absolutely vital. Peter, please pitch in $5 or whatever you can now to elect the next generation of leaders!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240315-1?refcode=em20240315-1&amount=5&refcode2=458_587540_CUwQXl&akid=458%2E587540%2ECUwQXl)
Thank you!!!
David Hogg
Leaders We Deserve

**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-footer?refcode=em20240315-1&t=2&refcode2=458_587540_CUwQXl&akid=458%2E587540%2ECUwQXl)**

body:
But I need your attention for just a moment
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1084%2E62735%2EBCFlHc)
Hey, Peter —
I had to quickly reach out because my finance team just let me know that **we’re only about $3,600 shy of hitting our mid-month target by tonight’s deadline.** We’re so close, and I can’t thank you enough for your support.
[](https://act.hillharper.com/go/762?t=2&akid=1084%2E62735%2EBCFlHc)
Meeting our goal is critical to ensuring we can keep our campaign’s momentum growing as we head into the next few months of the race. There’s a lot of hard work ahead of us, including traveling around the state to connect with voters and community leaders, distributing our campaign literature, and running ads so voters can get to know me and my message before the primary. As you can imagine, those costs will add up!
If you’re able, please use this personal link to make your first donation before midnight: **[secure.actblue.com/donate/bax_hh_mm24?refcode=LASTCHANCE](https://act.hillharper.com/go/762?t=3&akid=1084%2E62735%2EBCFlHc)**
Honestly, asking for money is my least favorite part of running for Senate. I’d rather direct that energy to time out on the campaign trail — on fighting for higher wages, workers’ rights, and universal health care — than on asking for donations.
**But the reality is this:** I’m up against serious establishment money in this race, on _both_ sides of the aisle. I don’t take big checks from corporate PACs or federal lobbyists. And, I turned down $20 million from one of AIPAC’s biggest donors — on the condition that I drop out and challenge Rep. Rashida Tlaib — so I could run the clean, grassroots campaign Michigan deserves.
Grassroots donations from folks like you make up the bulk of our support. I think it’s the right way to run our campaign — but it does mean I have to reach out a little more often to ask for your help.
And look, I know that this campaign isn’t about me or any one person. We’re building a community-first movement that starts and ends with the good people of Michigan. **That’s why I’m in this fight: to take our priorities to Washington and ensure our voices are echoed in the halls of power.**
So, if you’re able to give before tonight’s deadline, here’s that link one more time: **[secure.actblue.com/donate/bax_hh_mm24?refcode=LASTCHANCE](https://act.hillharper.com/go/762?t=4&akid=1084%2E62735%2EBCFlHc)**
Thank you for your ongoing support, Peter. The stakes are just too high to let up for a second.
Hill Harper
Democrat for U.S. Senate
[](https://act.hillharper.com/go/762?t=5&akid=1084%2E62735%2EBCFlHc)
* * *
**[DONATE »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bax_hh_email?refcode=bax_hh_emailfooter&t=6&refcode2=1084_62735_BCFlHc&akid=1084%2E62735%2EBCFlHc)**
