Subject: re: New York, Wisconsin, and Alabama

> Friends, part of my job here at All On The Line is to track the daily movements of state legislatures and courts in the fight for fair maps.
> And let me tell you: _a lot is happening right now!_
> **I hope you’ll take a minute to read my latest redistricting roundup below,** **[and then make a donation of $20.24 to help ensure we can keep working to end gerrymandering and restore fairness to our elections in each and every state we can.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81000125/461087284/-1898485638?refcode=20240315_AOTL_F_RoundupMarchLift_RedLiteXClickers&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjVkNjgwYzRmLWQ0ZTItZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=DzK-W4swXBPa5D3y155lsKsvH6uaYOCCKi5gthftH_I=)**
> [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81000126/461087285/-1898485638?refcode=20240315_AOTL_F_RoundupMarchLift_RedLiteXClickers&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjVkNjgwYzRmLWQ0ZTItZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=DzK-W4swXBPa5D3y155lsKsvH6uaYOCCKi5gthftH_I=)
> ---
> The state legislature recently approved a new set of fair congressional maps, and Gov. Kathy Hochul signed them into law, a victory that would not have been possible without this grassroots movement. We’re one big step closer to reaching a final congressional map nationwide for this year’s elections.
> [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81000127/461087286/-1898485638?refcode=20240315_AOTL_F_RoundupMarchLift_RedLiteXClickers&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjVkNjgwYzRmLWQ0ZTItZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=DzK-W4swXBPa5D3y155lsKsvH6uaYOCCKi5gthftH_I=)
> ---
> Earlier this month, the Wisconsin Supreme Court declined to hear a challenge to the state's gerrymandered congressional map. This isn’t the result we were hoping for, but the fight for fair maps in the Badger State is far from over.
> Let’s not forget that Governor Evers signed a new set of state legislative maps into law in February, marking the first time in over a decade that Wisconsin voters will have a fair opportunity to elect a truly representative and responsive state legislature! We’ve shown time and time again that when we organize, we can move the needle together.
> [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81000128/461087287/-1898485638?refcode=20240315_AOTL_F_RoundupMarchLift_RedLiteXClickers&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjVkNjgwYzRmLWQ0ZTItZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=DzK-W4swXBPa5D3y155lsKsvH6uaYOCCKi5gthftH_I=)
> ---
> And last week, we got a glimpse of what happens when you introduce more fairness and representation into our democracy. After a long legal fight that went all the way to the Supreme Court, Alabama finally has a map that complies with Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act, which requires a map in which Black voters have the opportunity to elect candidates of their choice in two districts. In the first primary election since the new AL-02 district was drawn, voter participation surged. That's why we do this work.
> [Help fight for fair maps →](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81000129/461087288/-1898485638?refcode=20240315_AOTL_F_RoundupMarchLift_RedLiteXClickers&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjVkNjgwYzRmLWQ0ZTItZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=DzK-W4swXBPa5D3y155lsKsvH6uaYOCCKi5gthftH_I=)
> ---

But as A.G. Holder says, we’re living in an era of perpetual redistricting — and that means we need your support now more than ever.**

clean_body: Help keep up the fight against gerrymandering nationwide → | Friends, I hope you’re following this: The fight for fair maps is happening all around us, and it’s reaching a fever pitch to lock in districts for the November election — the progress we’ve made in key states is all because of this grassroots team. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = – Brianna Shamsuddoha Director of Mobilization \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Claire Low, All On The Line Date: Wed, Mar 13, 2024 Subject: re: New York, Wisconsin, and Alabama Friends, part of my job here at All On The Line is to track the daily movements of state legislatures and courts in the fight for fair maps. And let me tell you: a lot is happening right now! I hope you’ll take a minute to read my latest redistricting roundup below, = = --- The state legislature recently approved a new set of fair congressional maps, and Gov. Kathy Hochul signed them into law, a victory that would not have been possible without this grassroots movement. We’re one big step closer to reaching a final congressional map nationwide for this year’s elections. = --- Earlier this month, the Wisconsin Supreme Court declined to hear a challenge to the state's gerrymandered congressional map. This isn’t the result we were hoping for, but the fight for fair maps in the Badger State is far from over. Let’s not forget that Governor Evers signed a new set of state legislative maps into law in February, marking the first time in over a decade that Wisconsin voters will have a fair opportunity to elect a truly representative and responsive state legislature! We’ve shown time and time again that when we organize, we can move the needle together. = --- And last week, we got a glimpse of what happens when you introduce more fairness and representation into our democracy. After a long legal fight that went all the way to the Supreme Court, Alabama finally has a map that complies with Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act, which requires a map in which Black voters have the opportunity to elect candidates of their choice in two districts. In the first primary election since the new AL-02 district was drawn, voter participation surged. That's why we do this work. = --- None of that progress is possible without you. There’s still more up in the air in states across the country — we’ll be in touch with more updates as they happen. With your support, All On The Line is leading the grassroots movement for fair maps. But as A.G. Holder says, we’re living in an era of perpetual redistricting — and that means we need your support now more than ever. = Thanks for being part of this movement, Claire Low Director of Political and Campaigns All On The Line is the grassroots advocacy campaign supported by the National Redistricting Action Fund. body:

---
Peter, as a young woman, I had an abortion.

It’s not a secret. It’s not shameful. And I share it because I want the millions of other women who’ve made the decision to seek abortion care to know that they’re not alone.

When I was 21, I found out I was pregnant. I was married and wanted to start a family, but a devastating medical diagnosis changed all my plans.

My doctors told me I had an aortic aneurysm at risk of rupture. To treat it, I first needed to have an abortion. **That abortion saved my life.**

This unprecedented witch hunt is one of the worst perversions of the rule of law that the United States has ever seen. The unabashed inversion of a foundational element of our justice system - that everyone is innocent until proven guilty - shows just how far the left will go to crucify individual liberties and completely upend due process. Please read my statement, share it, and then if you are able, help others being persecuted and hung out to dry by the left. | **__** **Tea Party Patriots Action Slams Ruling Keeping Fulton County DA on Trump Case ** Atlanta, GA - Today, Judge Scott McAfee ruled that Fulton County District Attorney Fani Willis and her office can continue prosecuting former President Donald Trump and his co-defendants only if special prosecutor Nathan Wade steps down. In response, Tea Party Patriots Action (TPPA) Honorary Chairman Jenny Beth Martin issued the following statement: "Judge McAfee's ruling is appalling. It is clear to any fair-minded person that Fani Willis disqualified herself by hiring her lover to lead the Trump prosecution, abusing government funds, and then engaging in perjury and obstruction of justice during her hearing. And then there's the fact that Willis' prosecution of Trump and his co-defendants has no basis in law and is naked election interference. This week, Gov. Kemp signed legislation that lets a state commission begin operating with powers to discipline and remove prosecutors. Because the state legislature in Georgia has abdicated its constitutional power to impeach, that commission must act to remove Willis immediately. Every moment this sham prosecution is allowed to continue is a total miscarriage of justice." **_[](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb97946ec88be4/1edb97946eb11bee "You can see Jenny Beth’s hour-long conversation with Andy here >>")_****__****_[](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb97946ec88be4/1edb97946eb11bf0 "That’s why we’ve compiled a list of items and services that will make fantastic gifts for the conservative in your life.")_****__**

Thank you.

| | When I announced this campaign last year, we hit the ground running. We’ve kept it up this year, too. Over the last several weeks, we’ve held numerous Reddy to Listen events across Kansas’ 3rd District. And last weekend, I spent time hearing from the Kansas Republican Women of the 3rd District.
---
|

[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/6dcc10b8ddad76db322761119fed00b9/43823/e20368774e3976293947229f28c3afba/fcd6ce3c2a9ae279c3d6b838967d376c/43823)

|

Traveling the district, making voter contacts, and getting the word out is tough (and also expensive) for any campaign. But that goes double when you’re an outsider running for office for the first time. We’re about halfway through the month of March, and on the 31st we’re facing our first major fundraising deadline of this election year. **[If you haven’t donated yet, there’s no better time than now. If you have but it’s been a while, there’s no better time to match your donation ahead of this critical moment.](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/6dcc10b8ddad76db322761119fed00b9/43823/e20368774e3976293947229f28c3afba/4fd926155239cf0cc3d6b838967d376c/43823)**

** __Meet Dr. Prasanth Reddy:__** Dr. Reddy is a cancer physician and immigrant who's lived the American Dream. In the aftermath of 9/11, he answered his country's call. Dr. Reddy is running for Congress against a Democrat who votes with Joe Biden 100% of the time, in one of the most competitive House districts in the country. # [#] Jersey is a state full of the best ideas. Many of the initiatives I’ve taken on in Washington have come directly from right here at home – from elected officials, business owners, and families up and down the state

As you might have heard, I recently launched JumpStart Jersey, an initiative highlighting the heroes and their ideas that make New Jersey the great state it is.

Today, we want to highlight Acting Mayor Cristina Cutrone, a teacher and leader in Fair Lawn, NJ!

Over the past 5 years, Fair Lawn’s water department has had to shut down some unsafe wells due to PFAs – or forever chemicals – and lead in drinking water. Last year, I worked alongside Acting Mayor Cutrone to secure a $3.4 million federal investment to safely reopen these wells and expand numerous clean-up efforts to address Fair Lawn’s decades of contaminated water supply. This work not only upgrades the town’s water treatment but saves residents money and protects them from the adverse health effects of water contamination.

If you want to read more about Acting Mayor Cutrone and her amazing work, click here! [https://www.jumpstartjersey.com/home/fair-lawn]

Friend --
Sometimes I look through my inbox at the endless barrage of emails from political campaigns and organizations and I wonder how anyone donates at all?
Some campaign has a triple-match offer (it's fake.)
Another campaign has an "official mid-month fundraising deadline” (not a real thing.)
And if you're inclined to donate, how do you choose between all the messages you’re getting?
First, I am grateful you've even opened this email. In the sea of political emails, even that is a small win (and it happens to help ensure our emails get into inboxes and not spam, so thank you.) These messages are important to me:**I write every single email we send you.**
As you read this, Trump is the Republican nominee for president. The Republican Senate candidates in Michigan are still fighting to see who the nominee will be.
But whoever they choose, we can expect this to be one of the most competitive and expensive races in the country. And this moment -- while they fight amongst themselves -- is an opportunity for me to introduce myself to voters in a way they can't while they fight to out-MAGA each other.
So please. This is a strategically important moment to donate to this campaign.
There's no way I could expect you to donate to every email we send, but I hope you will give to this one.

According to the _Center for American Women and Politics_ , in states where the filing deadlines have passed:

❌ Women only account for 24% of candidates for U.S. House of Representatives, 18.3% of U.S. Senate candidates, and 21.7% of gubernatorial candidates.

❌ The number of women candidates running for the U.S. House is **down** by 21.6% since 2022.

❌ 14 congresswomen (11 Democrats, 3 Republicans) have announced that they are not running for re-election to their current seats in Congress. According to Forbes, 9 congresswomen had announced their retirements from Congress with **no intention** of running for other public offices.

This is a record high for the number of voluntary departures for congresswomen in any single election cycle.

**Here’s what this means:
The U.S. is very likely to have fewer women in office next year than in previous years – reversing all of the important progress we’ve made since 2018 – unless we do something to stop this trend.**

We recognize that it’s harder for women to run for office. Women candidates are more likely to be subjected to sexual harassment, sexism, misogyny, double standards, and even death threats. CNN senior data reporter Harry Enten on Wednesday asserted former President Donald Trump’s lead over President Joe Biden significantly distinguishes the current election from the 2020 race. Trump and Biden both reached the necessary number of delegates to clinch their respective party nominations on Tuesday.

Read more https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c696380%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=RJL79HSE%2brfRMqWF1MdUkw&sysid=1

subject: Temporary protections were never enough ❌
body:
The latest court decision on DACA wasn’t good — and now we’re likely headed to the Supreme Court. | | | Peter: The most recent DACA decision by Judge Hanen was not a good result. Judge Hanen doubled down on his decision to halt new applications, leaving millions of immigrant youth stuck in limbo without protections. **Now, the case is likely headed to the Supreme Court by next year.** It has been YEARS of waiting from court case to court case — a reality where our protections can be stripped away on a random weekday. Years of temporary protections when we need permanent solutions. Years of anxiously living renewal to renewal, with no guarantee DACA will still be around after the next court decision. 🙃 **We’re done waiting. The truth is that for hundreds of thousands of immigrant youth who were shut out of the program after Judge Hanen’s ruling in 2021 — and millions more undocumented people who were never eligible — **DACA was never enough.** ❌

body:

Peter Willis, on Sunday,
Bernie was on Face The Nation advocating for Peace and an end to the
outrageous U.S. support for Netanyahu’s war in Gaza:

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/16129?t=1011&akid=5497%2E5885482%2EJ3LZsj ][IMG]

AIPAC and the GOP want Bernie and pro-Peace progressives to stay silent on
the 30,000 Palestinians killed by Israel — but that’s not an option and
Bernie is continuing his courageous advocacy.

Bernie just wrote a letter to President Biden stating that continuing to
send money and weapons to Israel is not only unconscionable, it’s a
violation of the Foreign Assistance Act — which bars military support from
going to any nation that restricts the delivery of humanitarian aid.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/16127?source=email-20240315&t=1012&akid=5497%2E5885482%2EJ3LZsj ]Support Bernie's letter to President Biden and add your name calling
for an end to all support for Netanyahu’s war in Gaza!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/16127?source=email-20240315&t=1013&akid=5497%2E5885482%2EJ3LZsj ]ADD YOUR NAME

Over 30,000 Palestinian civilians have now been killed in Gaza. And,
Netanyahu’s extreme right-wing government is blocking the food and water
Palestinian children need to survive. U.S. complicity in this horror must
end.

Bernie said on Face The Nation: “What you can say to Netanyahu, stop the
slaughter, allow the massive amounts of humanitarian aid that we need to
come in to feed the children. Please, please, please. Oh, but by the way,
if you don't do it, here's another $10 billion to continue the war.”

This is the kind of hypocrisy in the face of mass atrocities that is
coming to a head in the United States. And Bernie is not only calling out
the hypocrisy, he’s saying funding Netanyahu’s war is a violation of the
law.

We must continue amplifying Bernie’s call to protect the people of Gaza
and change the U.S. policies that are supporting the horrific violence
against the Palestinian people.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/16127?source=email-20240315&t=1014&akid=5497%2E5885482%2EJ3LZsj ]Stand with Bernie: Not another nickel for Netanyahu’s war! The U.S.

relentless bombing campaign in Gaza.

When we organize, we win.

disclaimer_text: Paid for by The Long Run PAC, P
body:
#
Friends -
Yesterday, I reached out to you about our mid-month deadline at midnight tonight. And today, I need to be honest with you about our progress.
We are in a critical position right now, pacing far behind our fundraising goal. This is not the news I wanted to share with you today.
The thing is, at this point in the month, we should be at least 35% to our fundraising goal, but right now, we are 23% of the way there.
That is not what I was expecting, but it is our reality — for now.
I know that if you can make your first contribution to The Long Run before midnight tonight, we can inch closer and closer to that 35% mark.
So please. I am asking:
[**Can you please make a $3 contribution to The Long Run ahead of our mid-month deadline at midnight tonight? We are quickly approaching our first end-of-quarter deadline of the election year and cannot afford to slow down.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-mar24.wCUGOx&refcode=em240315-1-tt&t=1&akid=5243%2E196590%2Ei21B0j)
_If you 've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
[Express Donate: $3](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1271?c0=longrunpac-em-mar24.y10yZW&amount=3&refcode=em240315-1-tt&t=20&akid=5243%2E196590%2Ei21B0j)

[Or donate another amount](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-mar24.wCUGOx&refcode=em240315-1-tt&t=25&akid=5243%2E196590%2Ei21B0j)
I know this grassroots team has the power to flip red seats blue come Election Day, whether that be in Texas’ all-important Senate Race, in New York's 22nd district, or in legislative races up and down the ballot in Wisconsin. But I am going to need you by my side to get there.

Mandela

And five reasons why it matters.
#
Peter — before we ask you to chip in $5 or more toward our goal of raising 2,500 individual donations, **here are five reasons why your support for Lucas Kunce _right now_ is so critical:**
**[CHIP IN NOW →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/44597?refcode=em20240315-5051&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5051%2E614464%2ERe_U1M)**
1. **Josh Hawley is seriously vulnerable.** Hawley won his last race with only 51% of the vote. And now, reporting from _Morning Consult_ shows that Hawley remains the least popular GOP U.S. Senator up for re-election in 2024 — with approval numbers even worse than Ted Cruz in Texas and Rick Scott in Florida!
2. **National Republicans are already targeting our race.** These insiders know that if they don’t step in to make Josh Hawley look strong, there’s a real chance they could lose this Senate seat. So from launching desperate attacks about Lucas to funding a new GOP Super PAC with millions of dollars, they’re already hard at work to keep this seat under their thumb.
3. **After major wins for red-state Democrats and abortion rights in Kentucky and Ohio, we have an opportunity to make Missouri next.** Over the last three election cycles, Missouri voters have broken with politicians like Hawley to reject anti-union “Right-to-Work,” raise the minimum wage, expand Medicaid, and legalize weed. So in 2024, we really can defeat Josh Hawley and take this Senate seat back for everyday people.
4. **Our movement can harness that grassroots energy.** From outraising Hawley’s campaign to earning support from dozens of statewide and local unions across Missouri, Lucas is proving that our election-winning message and sheer people-power will be a real force to be reckoned with.
5. **Multiple recent polls show Lucas Kunce in a _statistical tie_ with Josh Hawley.** After working hard to hold Hawley accountable, Lucas has already made this a margin-of-error race.

**Now, we’ve got to keep this momentum going.** Our first major FEC fundraising deadline of 2024 is just weeks away, so staying on track with our goals is the surest way we’ll be able to keep reaching voters with Lucas’ message, flip this Senate seat, and take back power for everyday people this November.

---
| |
---
You’ve probably caught wind of the buzz surrounding our new[ TikTok legislation](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=90abbe008a4a4576bf2c1261fa764f97&_e=pBS2JMaWspgc61t8UqkaM3yHOx3Bsb4nb-vzKrjzGBQrwjUo4vKNaMwh2MmaO4tKOav3KTjMnyzcO9oB2n143tumhRQDf5kpkCsHpOuGSnHSJFnJFPdzJcDNgwyUmrLFCNeZhJdfGJvRnCvt2ToID9nMhDJgiyFhOKrt8YHXVzytL5hJqvE4g7MUcXjorU2J6mRzhCkb0eBPh22rtJjebb0GIU45I5lsCu3bqA2bd9q8WvcwQUqUCsKZEdVEsS2VgZpt0dvLI7HiMf23Edbc5w%3D%3D), so I want to clear the air on a few things. Contrary to the chatter, [the bill we passed](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=90abbe008a4a4576bf2c1261fa764f97&_e=pBS2JMaWspgc61t8UqkaM_L3qLV_NiaZbZ7yaFSEyuWTawYeGs-AZ5r7U0wJsWQAvk2WhjxBsNB1S1WCeSRxe9wnP6TaEshobzmyPm5P9Cz9a7q7d-hP80JaTZwQBHC5E5hA2TyT2ZZLiGmvVDaBcJxClgZ-Af2op9M4MOE2pzK4RNMzj1jShHuKe2OsmeD4DALWbsAHo8L2FuvhWnkIyGSpPh58IvUKC98WQXQQxxpYgfY8MnIQdb-cygXEySTFL7q4FXiJcHfLq9EToF2puQ%3D%3D) in the House doesn’t ban TikTok—yet. We’re simply trying to get the app out from under the Communist Chinese government’s thumb. No one believes in freedom more than I do; you folks know that by now. I’m willing to admit I was a bit uneasy about some of the things in this bill, but overall, I’m confident we’re on the right track. TikTok's parent company, [ByteDance](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=90abbe008a4a4576bf2c1261fa764f97&_e=pBS2JMaWspgc61t8UqkaM7c8jAzUgJ6nFH4xThp6_e5reO6h69C91oQoXZEATVSgB_t2_NGfN9_jFeSaeAbT2xhsdphLcmveRtydinRvblDLTkwjZ2PDa6pLdGcZODy2K9XHJSyJptE8zwfFRvsuZH5r2917fBV4vJtvo_qCxdMAT3BpI0vRl05HqlIYXqnsDw9YUHsr0rpdgpMx9Z8Tmm9P2kCZlyv5nrRihHjy06FDEQOCpxnmlffkAuYsSMoLWsxHb-nadvIxnNn27G4SSIPeNki_f7CzwTOS2gn-4bVzEHnjiDDxF3w7IdY6G2IbEFlcSZ6fbjkTyhM3lH4XqQ%3D%3D), isn't a random private company that happens to be located in China. The Chinese Communist Party controls ByteDance, making it part of China's military complex. Keeping ByteDance-owned TikTok on our phones is like allowing the CCP to peer into Americans’ everyday lives, harvest our data, and [brainwash](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=90abbe008a4a4576bf2c1261fa764f97&_e=pBS2JMaWspgc61t8UqkaM1NigVeMVEZHjbXFRI4iLaUX-A3vvYxWnKM6AlR2Mf3Tt1H5KaWBLlvQ5ww8RXyfati2mgobPMOLxGUU2eWAeWwh4LQ0rnkB6QF80bstvT4efPxHLU_ZTr3kju2-fe7ydJtQOgWqeIsRK3rzEtMGxk8C3Lv62g68JZkJNgxTxWUVMa_sji_bfbHKgSSq1ntiDFE0P9a4Iq5jK7vZv4wS1TfDsehJLE8_9fZTK6GfxHYwfoAVebYgeb0-Js05iRr056WgG1VS0lPxaaFDwfqCpz4XLwaWXePMUpSk0ABO8nZR) our kids along the way. Our office phones were [flooded this week](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=90abbe008a4a4576bf2c1261fa764f97&_e=pBS2JMaWspgc61t8UqkaMwmTxMGdVW1ibTtUT07odMi0QPwayIHotW8CcZNLl19NN_FE0lWi-L9H3FIvZPa5UuJ0WHONMqWMx7QIqsQn_ShapiBt1jzz986iwy0eleoFNFOtZ1J_OYspSDLHMA8uowVVOMz91jZGVK7JusgvyvI7wpsgoUg-qJB6ZaKEokQ5nusHyM2v6MsaNKf86MGvcZvwBS7zjELpdRJc1So8k4ekZT-JVO6l-G1gMZeJnNBVjtk6D5JuK-osB4Q314twqogCXuH7yUwdw3ayVksD1suKdQzI_RaMCCCTMtLgiJoKVr7PTu5y2Ae2Mn4eDPruDvlt0J1LghIaSziKCxw8HMg%3D) with teens who were highly emotional about this move. Some even [threatened suicide](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=90abbe008a4a4576bf2c1261fa764f97&_e=pBS2JMaWspgc61t8UqkaM_L3qLV_NiaZbZ7yaFSEyuUNUEyBDeht3dsNKZduqpyofW-ceAcAJne6_zY3SSXbME7uFpTV3CQgr_NbelOckN7oPXm0uRcgf3P2LDINy_nUJ8UCSVLmmk42gRyq6FUeDtqUnkZeom9ERlvwKx4v0UhAnueYMMmBt8ZtqWxLdzcKyGv1x6G-x0fG6tGOnlYO3XKtqii0ymQ6BZFsTMLmZVmlmoO0ZsDjTs10ZlaKblsf1gmkZChehSyBzTYFsqr_gH7yRhHmEyw3-0zF7YKWH1M1vHb3260_56wKhj8EOFKrsQ45oJwESyo_Hq99aKkPjQ%3D%3D) if we ban this thing, and if that doesn’t scare the living daylights out of you, I don’t know what will. Do we need any more proof that TikTok is a toxic force that’s [destroying our children](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=90abbe008a4a4576bf2c1261fa764f97&_e=pBS2JMaWspgc61t8UqkaM1lLwiCKwywpvYbB4WwpKsScDKEG5kV-esjUjciAC_nmWEpybKbnVr6aKGhYZtI2A0erDfoJi0icmjtuWOqo1fotFF-TYGr2sUbllIW38LL5w_XIq17rVk639YgXT23cHR1gEOSxNjOqA_VAmpOytgKJ3fcXKP7Cjh_Fy19xCouqDCFtR0uJQIZSYckkh7N9pkB3KRP2oyjP84ErpRLY4n5ib3o2XspQiUutxcsDur1-y3A560dnivw6yAUAHih9tL_mMKEM1Z59YVXZd1f5RWkattavaihoRcWDt4UU2SlHm6GtpFEmjy4gvfm9-CMWJboeF1fk-FY42__gDPzigQfE-YYi9YCV9tVF0v0g24Ku)? Something of this magnitude with such an enormous level of[ influence](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=90abbe008a4a4576bf2c1261fa764f97&_e=pBS2JMaWspgc61t8UqkaM5CiNmYlV135TEk25qkIv0sjvkBzjiHGwyaP6N68kHWykH0joQ_C_3jFWV7RJDwOynC2u-UH2yMxFb7qBM0iWgbad6T3V1-rXhgF04hd697Bf9r6TLaBL7GPwD0WGDQUmSuBZYofk8pwl230QCNIAcSnDHORLcS-J1up47HigV4w7ces2XH7yEpWDkX_3HvNbUqdtHwq1HtEqM6Ub6CZobLsT_cjVNAjTyjjay2i4icBpHvvk0AhvQ24NN_pIyK0XA%3D%3D) can’t be trusted in the hands of the Chinese, Iranians, or Russians. To get it under American oversight, this bill requires[ ByteDance](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=90abbe008a4a4576bf2c1261fa764f97&_e=pBS2JMaWspgc61t8UqkaM8JsPYBs_1-HVERGbNaZSJEd9tBri4DYqmrfIQ-8f-mF5hnJaqx8zrFOiGcxmGhwr2esKoS03P7z7Tdlh6AzXDNEL9W9_kak_zN_4BqsxL_6eOtWok6doB4qAKyljOLKgqiEZZxtJDrnIzcDGhiQx7Eob1IoRljl3BM0PLpjdfXGHhmd_hJ2GqCgW6fxQyIXrcYK3GYC3MOWVD7r6AWY4MJVjjwI36vAb055qPgT1J6OS7Ilr0XoIbJEOd-R5FM-lukx5xR1Kea1QyHmhpf4FFNX7s8F61MkWmA5vkj-wHjf), TikTok’s parent company, to sell the app within six months. If they brush us off, that’s when it will disappear from U.S. app stores and hosting services. To stop this fiasco from happening again, the bill also gives the president power to ask other foreign adversary-controlled apps to sell off if they pose a national security threat and have more than a million monthly users. But while the House really rallied around this bill, its future is [on shaky ground in the Senate.](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=90abbe008a4a4576bf2c1261fa764f97&_e=pBS2JMaWspgc61t8UqkaMyT5Sga3nsSd2ZmlNeyBNqZeiEYOC0tToj6r3Tmxw3eMm61ALaP6qzczk6wcE93gsm-MSKbuHE44rh776B_qpQOWQBfHtZVQk_eBy1LOsqpw2CoAP3860UPwubDBBfsSJpYtbYDfD9lnrsvFD8W7ptGcLvOlAYjsXwjE5GJeWpxkK5HhWGWu_q2fdkkPJPiZzGOXoX2o7ZC3dJt0QkMAbt4CzC1V4IOdyONscGEOXvStqYKlgwu3lVjVm_vzo2po572BsG9eNWfE3swWx-Pxe24%3D) If it sees the light of day on the other side, the folks over at TikTok have some big decisions to make. So, could TikTok be on the chopping block? Only time will tell. All this boils down to protecting Americans, especially our children, from bad actors who don’t have our best interests in mind. It’s a responsibility I don’t take lightly, and I’m hopeful we can find our way out of this mess.

| | A sea of green will take to the streets of Knoxville this weekend for our annual St. Patrick’s Day parade! In case you missed it, [WalletHub](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=90abbe008a4a4576bf2c1261fa764f97&_e=pBS2JMaWspgc61t8UqkaMyDpZ7LSHnoUBdLrOA47WyfAp0ck8HAZs7ffoweHX6XkX1SKNjn7wEONt2JZFJlz0hel2uagMb5_gHfV_npZ6gz9qEoF5Nk62ODBO5eHaaQlXKz_Reb9kpGf008P7bpXm9AwYFlJ_Nf_kAfO7Bv-OLoo16vBwT0fOk7b-5vqrXVD8dm3ylj3QyQvtgH7QQY0qL7hPkz31QRcz_BPgH_d7m6VeMIQGs8PIYHL6knEZh1xl_fNzrP7J2jyS-1ktrN9aX9yhsVWENvzP6SYekC8D2ro75gjEOMJnLHf_PzURzPcB9ouJ1o5wmVdk-XCdSsp4pSUkc72cIXKsbxVQqIAM44%3D) ranked Knoxville at #13 on their list of the best cities to celebrate St. Patrick’s Day—and it’s easy to see why. According to the [Knoxville History Project](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=90abbe008a4a4576bf2c1261fa764f97&_e=pBS2JMaWspgc61t8UqkaM_LhYsNer_QIhWUl1-HsN80AgE4Bb6sMX9TfMVoK3LPD-GLsyQAHHP65Uhs-3AVb2G9v7wk2igTKrZOzYP-SZHfctettQ1C7rHI3thTO0cwOeIi71pKx7rrR4bd-YHEafeaePJFBHfpvskEk0_CH2wmr2Ww23up8pF68K-89ZXFBCiu3xfXR-6bTqK5ofQVjZj1Gizcz7dXlPJQn76jKWBgMTiPj3LgMhb7fe-ULiKTS34UzUds2eQzTZqGNQs9BlQ%3D%3D), our St. Patrick’s Day celebrations date all the way back to the 1850s, which makes sense when you consider many of our early founders were Irish immigrants. After the parade was canceled three years in a row due to COVID and weather, last year was a huge hit. Chilly temperatures couldn’t stop crowds from showing up in droves, and I have a feeling we can expect the same kind of enthusiasm this year. It’s an event that always brings our community together, and for that, I’m grateful! Put on your green gear and join the fun tomorrow at 1 p.m. in downtown Knoxville. Happy St. Patrick’s Day!

clean_body: TIMtalk will keep you updated on the important issues and goings-on in our campaign, in Tennessee, and in our country.| | | | | **The TikTok Truth 📱 | | You’ve probably caught wind of the buzz surrounding our new, so I want to clear the air on a few things. Contrary to the chatter, in the House doesn’t ban TikTok—yet. We’re simply trying to get the app out from under the Communist Chinese government’s thumb. No one believes in freedom more than I do; you folks know that by now. I’m willing to admit I was a bit uneasy about some of the things in this bill, but overall, I’m confident we’re on the right track. TikTok's parent company, , isn't a random private company that happens to be located in China. The Chinese Communist Party controls ByteDance, making it part of China's military complex. Keeping ByteDance-owned TikTok on our phones is like allowing the CCP to peer into Americans’ everyday lives, harvest our data, and our kids along the way. Our office phones were with teens who were highly emotional about this move. Some even if we ban this thing, and if that doesn’t scare the living daylights out of you, I don’t know what will. Do we need any more proof that TikTok is a toxic force that’s ? Something of this magnitude with such an enormous level of can’t be trusted in the hands of the Chinese, Iranians, or Russians. To get it under American oversight, this bill requires, TikTok’s parent company, to sell the app within six months. If they brush us off, that’s when it will disappear from U.S. app stores and hosting services. To stop this fiasco from happening again, the bill also gives the president power to ask other foreign adversary-controlled apps to sell off if they pose a national security threat and have more than a million monthly users. But while the House really rallied around this bill, its future is If it sees the light of day on the other side, the folks over at TikTok have some big decisions to make. So, could TikTok be on the chopping block? Only time will tell. All this boils down to protecting Americans, especially our children, from bad actors who don’t have our best interests in mind. It’s a responsibility I don’t take lightly, and I’m hopeful we can find our way out of this mess. | | | | | St. Patrick’s Day in East Tennessee 🍀 | | A sea of green will take to the streets of Knoxville this weekend for our annual St. Patrick’s Day parade! In case you missed it, ranked Knoxville at #13 on their list of the best cities to celebrate St. Patrick’s Day—and it’s easy to see why. According to the , our St. Patrick’s Day celebrations date all the way back to the 1850s, which makes sense when you consider many of our early founders were Irish immigrants. After the parade was canceled three years in a row due to COVID and weather, last year was a huge hit. Chilly temperatures couldn’t stop crowds from showing up in droves, and I have a feeling we can expect the same kind of enthusiasm this year. It’s an event that always brings our community together, and for that, I’m grateful! Put on your green gear and join the fun tomorrow at 1 p.m. in downtown Knoxville. # Vote Early _or_ Vote on Tuesday, March 19th!
---
| |
---
|
### This year I voted early at the Board of Elections.
There were no lines, and the process was smooth and easy. I'd strongly encourage you to visit the Cuyahoga County Board of Elections this weekend to vote early like me. That way, you're done; you don't need to remember to make the time on Tuesday to vote. Of course, you can always vote in person at your [designated polling place](https://tristanrader.us15.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe296f262404fb3f98dc9e04f&id=b354f8ad2a&e=869bcf0641) this Tuesday, March 19th. Every vote is crucial in shaping our future. Make your voice heard!

**Early voting is available:**

**\- Friday, March 15, from 7:30 AM to 7:30 PM
\- Saturday, March 16, from 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM
\- Sunday, March 17, from 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM**

MAKE SURE YOU BRING A VALID STATE ID!!

Free parking is available!
**Surface Lot Address:** 3100 Chester Ave, Cleveland, Ohio, 44114 (Campus International School)
**BOE Lot:** 2925 Euclid Avenue, Cleveland, Ohio, 44114

# _Fundraiser Tomorrow!_

Just a quick reminder about our upcoming fundraiser this **Saturday, March 16th, from 3:00PM to 5:00PM** at the home of Dr. Matthew & Sarah Badgett, 13488 Lake Ave, Lakewood, OH 44107.

Your support is invaluable to us, whether as a host, sponsor, backer, or guest. If you haven’t RSVP’d yet, there’s still time to join us in making a real impact for the people of Cleveland and Lakewood. I hope to see you tomorrow! [RSVP here](https://tristanrader.us15.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe296f262404fb3f98dc9e04f&id=63535b49b0&e=869bcf0641)

**Can't make it?** You can still support Tristan’s vision for a sustainable, just, and thriving Ohio by [contributing online](https://tristanrader.us15.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe296f262404fb3f98dc9e04f&id=844805dcfb&e=869bcf0641). Every bit helps us move closer to our goals.

Thank you for your ongoing support. Together, we can make a difference!

Tristan

You may have noticed the dog in the photos at the top of every email – that's Vince Neil (yes, named after the lead singer of Mötley Crüe). | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81026041/461155379/1655983737?refcode=EM_FL_EHA_20240315_fr_story_cand_mf_30da_xx_img&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzM5OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMzA0MTUwYy1lZmUyLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CqmSDb04MwPfaTy9ZGQ8Q7gloG74IpH7GfOcLiFqzgE=)
---
Vince was my dog from 2011 to 2021, when he passed away from old age. And what bonded us most is we were both scrappy underdogs.
Vince Neil was rescued on the side of the road, likely after living in the woods for years. We called him a "retired cowboy" because of it. One veterinarian even found BBs embedded in his chest. What he'd all gone through before I adopted him, we never knew.
I grew up bouncing around Southeastern Pennsylvania, sometimes pouring water on my cereal because we didn't have money for milk. I joined the Army for stability and as a way to pay for college.
Vince and I both managed to find stability and a comfortable life as adults. **But in this race, I'm still the scrappy underdog.**
I'm up against a well-connected incumbent who rode his brother's coattails, takes money from corporate PACs (I don't), and rolls over for MAGA in the hopes it keeps him in power.

One veterinarian even found BBs embedded in his chest. What he'd all gone through before I adopted him, we never knew. I grew up bouncing around Southeastern Pennsylvania, sometimes pouring water on my cereal because we didn't have money for milk. I joined the Army for stability and as a way to pay for college. 1. Reimagining Election Finance: A National Challenge

---
| | The cost of elections has become a national problem, and we must find a better way to manage the democratic process of elevating individuals to the role of public servants. According to [NBC News](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/5bOv34_aq/c?w=rFAjHyDFOGLnw35RoJCFR4-wK8dftV2X1BW-oUddTfs.), the cost of elections is estimated to be four times higher in 2024 than in 2016. With each battleground and high-profile election, costs are reaching unprecedented levels, often unjustified.
---
| |
---
| | Election cycle politics primarily focuses on fundraising and winning the election. However, I believe both of these goals are flawed. Firstly, fundraising is not merely about appropriately funding a race; it has become an industry where profitability is the primary goal. This has led to an uncomfortable arrangement between politicians, constituents, and consultants. Politicians are pressured to raise sufficient funds to avoid losing, constituents are persuaded to donate to ensure their candidate's success, and consultants operate within this system.
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/5bOv34_aq/c?w=mDOkq0a0liKf-UmA3HkSTKSf3ZLkCiryqszTyRdCGz0.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly91c2FmYWN0cy5vcmcvYXJ0aWNsZXMvZm91ci0yMDIyLXNlbmF0ZS1jYW1wYWlnbnMtZmluYW5jZWQtb3Zlci01MDAtbWlsbGlvbi13aGVyZS1kaWQtdGhhdC1tb25leS1jb21lLWZyb20vIiwiciI6IjdlZjRmY2IyLTVhMGMtNDBjMC04NGViLWVkZDhhZmUzZDc0ZSIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9)
---
| | In 2022, the top four Senate races collectively spent close to $600 million, arguably far beyond what was needed. This is a staggering amount of money raised by each candidate, with Democrats raising what many consider an excessive amount, far surpassing their Republican counterparts ([USAFacts](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/5bOv34_aq/c?w=bU-GYp6ojOp9D9PX9g5OshqVd_ZoTZJR9XYnYl9qswo.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly91c2FmYWN0cy5vcmcvYXJ0aWNsZXMvZm91ci0yMDIyLXNlbmF0ZS1jYW1wYWlnbnMtZmluYW5jZWQtb3Zlci01MDAtbWlsbGlvbi13aGVyZS1kaWQtdGhhdC1tb25leS1jb21lLWZyb20vIiwiciI6IjVjMTI1MDc2LTFmNTktNGUxNC04N2FjLTJhNTljYmRlYjI4ZCIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9)). The proportionality no longer makes sense and this leads to my second contention on whether winning an election is the correct goal? A presidential election is undoubtedly crucial, but for the House and Senate, retaining control of their respective chambers is paramount. According to [FEC-reported finances](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/5bOv34_aq/c?w=bfc2E5G2E08Milh0Da0qG9AD-qLPZkb62UVpUzsEwtw.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmVjLmdvdi91cGRhdGVzL3N0YXRpc3RpY2FsLXN1bW1hcnktb2YtMTgtbW9udGgtY2FtcGFpZ24tYWN0aXZpdHktb2YtdGhlLTIwMjEtMjAyMi1lbGVjdGlvbi1jeWNsZS8iLCJyIjoiNWMxMjUwNzYtMWY1OS00ZTE0LTg3YWMtMmE1OWNiZGViMjhkIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0) for Senate and House races from 2018 to 2022, the average spending for a Senate race was $3 million, while a House seat averaged a mere $665,000. It's perplexing to consider that if the $200 million raised by the top four Democrats over their Republican opponents had been distributed more evenly, rather than solely focused on holding the Senate, we might have achieved a supermajority.
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/5bOv34_aq/c?w=ZGjWGEj7px3jiyzHL74TsZA-cTENhykzBVP2sBpqzyo.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly91c2FmYWN0cy5vcmcvYXJ0aWNsZXMvZm91ci0yMDIyLXNlbmF0ZS1jYW1wYWlnbnMtZmluYW5jZWQtb3Zlci01MDAtbWlsbGlvbi13aGVyZS1kaWQtdGhhdC1tb25leS1jb21lLWZyb20vIiwiciI6IjExODBjYTU1LWVmOTktNGMxZi1iNjkyLWZhYTdkMGFhMmJlNiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9)
---
| | Where does this money come from? Not surprisingly, it does not primarily come from their home districts. As shown in the chart above, the percentage of funds received from out-of-district sources ranges from 59% for Rubio to 91% for Warnock. It's hard to imagine that there were no other races closer to home for donors that were equally or more deserving of funding. If you live in Central or Eastern Washington, you know that we lack state representation, have no voice in the US House, and our local elections often feature disproportionately far-right candidates. So, before you donate $25 to a candidate on the other side of the country, please consider this article. Unless it's for the President, contrary to popular belief, it's not the most crucial race in the nation. This is the first in a multi-part series and here are some additional links you might be interested in:[https://www.transparencyusa.org/](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/5bOv34_aq/c?w=8AVeEjQeCkky8ABam_k3qMBASiqw6Y2DGLV4of8dGJ0.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cudHJhbnNwYXJlbmN5dXNhLm9yZy8iLCJyIjoiZTJiNDA2YjQtOWQ4Mi00OTViLTllOTItN2QwYzJjZDBkMzVlIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0)[https://www.opensecrets.org/](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/5bOv34_aq/c?w=igk16QWx0kHdD6u1A4qnOhNOKvkdsXtSINpMerxI3Sk.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cub3BlbnNlY3JldHMub3JnLyIsInIiOiJlMmI0MDZiNC05ZDgyLTQ5NWItOWU5Mi03ZDBjMmNkMGQzNWUiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ) [https://www.pdc.wa.gov/](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/5bOv34_aq/c?w=qH_bQc_N5-esFi6Ehb_NlKu9GVRHlBseuJuTJRp_fWU.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucGRjLndhLmdvdi8iLCJyIjoiZTJiNDA2YjQtOWQ4Mi00OTViLTllOTItN2QwYzJjZDBkMzVlIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0) [https://www.fec.gov/data/](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/5bOv34_aq/c?w=u8jGaKqQL3z6MWFMkK31eT0ndO7eP534VSym6yx1rCM.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmVjLmdvdi9kYXRhLyIsInIiOiJlMmI0MDZiNC05ZDgyLTQ5NWItOWU5Mi03ZDBjMmNkMGQzNWUiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ)

---

She was the Democratic Representative from California’s 47th district who, with little more than a whiteboard and simple math, made CEOs crumble before her. She was magnificent. So why, when she ran for Dianne Feinstein’s open seat against Adam Schiff (D) CA-30, did she get treated so poorly? Your first thought might be that he spent it on his advertising, but you would be wrong. You might think he ran negative ads against her, and whereas that would be cheap, it would still be within the rules, but you would be wrong. If you guessed that he ran ads to promote the Republican opponent Steve Garvey so that he would get through the jungle primary (top two vote-getters), you would be right. I have seen low in my day, but that is beyond the pale. Katie Porter had more adversaries than just Schiff. An article published by [Slate](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/5bOv34_aq/c?w=RW4T9hz6IU6eZgvf0d047SFs3WwTosBoZ0eA2VG-2v8.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zbGF0ZS5jb20vbmV3cy1hbmQtcG9saXRpY3MvMjAyNC8wMy9jYWxpZm9ybmlhLWRlbW9jcmF0cy1wb3J0ZXItc2VuYXRlLXNjaGlmZi1nYXJ2ZXktcmlnZ2VkLmh0bWwiLCJyIjoiOGJlZTA4MTctNGU2Zi00NDczLWJmZTUtOWY0Y2UyZjdlYjU2IiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0) stated that the [Winklevoss twins](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/5bOv34_aq/c?w=5khGUP0VADF6-E413bAPSG_rf1kbNeJLTE0R0VVIouk.) kicked in another $5 million to make sure she did not make it through the primary. Do the simple math here: Adam Schiff was so intimidated by her capability that he spent a huge sum to promote a Republican opponent to shut her out, and the Winklevoss twins spent $5 million of their own money to make sure she did not get the Senate Seat. To me, that adds up to the best replacement for the bigger-than-life career of Dianne Feinstein not going to the best person, but to the person who was able to raise such an excess of campaign money he had enough to ruin another Democrat. Next time you are writing a donation check, remember that you know your neighbors best and our struggle is equal or more than anyone else.

Reimagining Election Finance: A National Challenge | | The cost of elections has become a national problem, and we must find a better way to manage the democratic process of elevating individuals to the role of public servants. According to , the cost of elections is estimated to be four times higher in 2024 than in 2016. With each battleground and high-profile election, costs are reaching unprecedented levels, often unjustified. | | | | Election cycle politics primarily focuses on fundraising and winning the election. However, I believe both of these goals are flawed. Firstly, fundraising is not merely about appropriately funding a race; it has become an industry where profitability is the primary goal. This has led to an uncomfortable arrangement between politicians, constituents, and consultants. Politicians are pressured to raise sufficient funds to avoid losing, constituents are persuaded to donate to ensure their candidate's success, and consultants operate within this system. | | | | In 2022, the top four Senate races collectively spent close to $600 million, arguably far beyond what was needed. This is a staggering amount of money raised by each candidate, with Democrats raising what many consider an excessive amount, far surpassing their Republican counterparts (). The proportionality no longer makes sense and this leads to my second contention on whether winning an election is the correct goal? A presidential election is undoubtedly crucial, but for the House and Senate, retaining control of their respective chambers is paramount. According to for Senate and House races from 2018 to 2022, the average spending for a Senate race was $3 million, while a House seat averaged a mere $665,000. It's perplexing to consider that if the $200 million raised by the top four Democrats over their Republican opponents had been distributed more evenly, rather than solely focused on holding the Senate, we might have achieved a supermajority. | | | | Where does this money come from? Not surprisingly, it does not primarily come from their home districts. As shown in the chart above, the percentage of funds received from out-of-district sources ranges from 59% for Rubio to 91% for Warnock. It's hard to imagine that there were no other races closer to home for donors that were equally or more deserving of funding. By Illinois Review

>From the very moment President Donald Trump secured enough delegates to clinch the Republican nomination for President of the United States, state Republican organizations from across the country immediately began posting congratulatory messages on their official state parties’ social media pages.

“Congratulations to President Donald J. Trump on becoming the presumptive Republican nominee for President of the United States,” said the Republican Party of Wisconsin on their Facebook page.

“Congratulations to Donald Trump on officially becoming the presumptive GOP nominee. Now we need to focus on uniting to beat Joe Biden in November. Trump is leading Biden in Maine polls. Our electoral college voters are in play and could be decisive. Help us win: go to MaineGOP.com to pitch in,” wrote the Maine Republican Party.

“Chairman McDonald has been with President Trump since 2015, he was the very first RNC Member to endorse him! Chairman McDonald & the NVGOP have continued to be supporters of our former President. We’d like to congratulate him on his victories last night! Onward to November!,” wrote the Nevada GOP.

And “Congratulations President Trump, the 2024 Republican nominee for President,” wrote the Republican Party of Kentucky.

The Illinois Republican Party, however, remains silent, preferring to post about proposed tax hikes in Chicago instead.

Yet Carlson kept the lies going on-air because Trump’s false election conspiracy drove high ratings and profits.
While no longer with Fox, Carlson has clearly learned from his experience. In his new streaming show, Carlson has repeatedly suggested that January 6th rioters were “set-up” by law enforcement.

Similar to his Dominion lies, Carlson claims that Democrats are planning to use mail-in voting and ballot dropboxes to facilitate another steal.
This is all, of course, total BS. Audit after audit has found that the United States has fair elections, and voter fraud is not a concern.
Carlson knows this, too, but he doesn’t care because pushing Trump’s conspiracy theories keeps the money rolling in.
Damage to our democracy be damned.

This is a perilous moment for our country, and here at COURIER, we work around the clock to protect democracy from right-wing bad actors like Carlson and Trump. # **A Message from the Chairwoman**
---
| | ** _Keeping Our Foot on the Gas!_**
---
Friends, The 2024 legislative session concluded last week in what was another successful session in which Republicans worked together to deliver for Hoosiers and their families. This session can also serve as a reminder that our elections have consequences. **_This is why we work hard to elect Republicans in all 92 counties - so that we can continue prioritizing Hoosier values._** While Democrats in D.C. breed dysfunction with massive deficits and gridlock, Republicans in Indiana deliver results. This session, our Republican legislators worked to improve our education system, infrastructure, public safety, and more. While Democrats in our Nation's Capital continue to fail the American people, Hoosier Republicans lead! It is imperative that we stay focused and keep our foot on the gas! _**The consequences of the 2024 election will be HUGE!** _ It is up to us to put in the work to strengthen our county party organizations and support our candidates so that we can elect Republican leadership at every level of government. Please sign up [HERE](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/c1bcb2927149bcb13947229f28c3afba/b1985bc8a8113bd5c3d6b838967d376c/40313) to help us continue to build on our success and take back the White House in 2024. Thank you for all that you do.
---

Chairwoman Anne F. Hathaway

# 🌟 Legislative Session Recap 🏛️

---
---
| | **See below for examples of effective Republican legislation that has been signed into law and will continue to take Indiana to the Next Level! ** [Senate Enrolled Act 1: Reading Skills](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/c1bcb2927149bcb13947229f28c3afba/1500d2c6865789d1c3d6b838967d376c/40313)
* Sets goal for 3rd grade students to reach 95% reading proficiency by 2027.
* Mandates schools to identify struggling readers earlier, such as administering IREAD in second grade.
* Requires that summer school reading programs are offered to students not on track for reading proficiency.

[Senate Enrolled Act 2: Child care](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/c1bcb2927149bcb13947229f28c3afba/ff1162f47b4d6163c3d6b838967d376c/40313)
* Provides Hoosiers more access to quality child care.
* Expands eligibility for the state’s On My Way Pre-K Program and state-administered Child Care and Development Fund (CCDF) vouchers for the employees of licensed child care entities, providing free or reduced cost child care to members of this critical workforce who earn up to 85 percent of the state’s median income.
* Enables more K-12 public schools to qualify as eligible providers for the On My Way Pre-K Program.

[Senate Enrolled Act 5: Lead water line replacement and lead remediation](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/c1bcb2927149bcb13947229f28c3afba/3299e2fa636c37cec3d6b838967d376c/40313)
* Upgrades lead pipes to protect Hoosiers' health.
* Enable utility companies with Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission-approved lead line service replacement plans to replace lead pipes more quickly and in a more cost-effective way.
* There are more than 265,000 lead water lines still in use in Indiana. Since lead pipes are known to cause severe health problems in children and adults, SEA 5 would enable utility companies to replace them quickly, efficiently and at a lower cost.

[House Bill 1001: Education and higher education matters](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/c1bcb2927149bcb13947229f28c3afba/a196932c627508fbc3d6b838967d376c/40313)
* Expands the Frank O'Bannon Grant and the 21st Century Scholarship beyond traditional college coursework to include job training.
* Expands options for career scholarships accounts (CSAs) that pay for students to pursue internships and apprenticeships with local industries.
* Extends eligibility for Education Scholarship Accounts (ESAs) to the siblings of students who have disabilities.

[House Bill 1003: Administrative law](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/c1bcb2927149bcb13947229f28c3afba/66f536c8ba0696e8c3d6b838967d376c/40313)
* Creates a more efficient and balanced appeals process that is presided over by administrative law judges.
* Makes rulings by the Office of Administrative Law Proceeding final for disputes between agencies and Hoosiers, and would increase consistency and efficiency in the resolution of these cases.

[House Bill 1004: Pension matters](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/c1bcb2927149bcb13947229f28c3afba/a8c0770f34fc86e8c3d6b838967d376c/40313)
* Provides a one-time, post-retirement payment designed to help cover cost-of-living gaps.
* Retired public employees like teachers, state excise police, gaming agents, gaming control officers, conservation officers and state police officers who are a part of Indiana’s public pension program will receive a 13th check.

Applications are open for the 2024 Republican National Convention Internship Program! The Committee on Arrangements (“COA”) plans for and manages the Republican National Convention. See the one pager with more information above. To apply for the COA Internship Program, please submit the following:

clean_body: | | | Peter, The New York Times is reporting that AIPAC is urging Republican big-money donors to spend even more to defeat Squad members like Jamaal Bowman and Cori Bush — and that they invited both Jamaal's and Cori's primary opponents as guests of honor at a major donor summit this week, along with a video appearance from disgraced Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu: We already knew that the Republican megadonors who fund AIPAC planned to spend over $100 million to defeat progressives in Democratic primaries this year. Now it looks like they are planning to spend even more. We’ve proven we don’t need to match them dollar-for-dollar in order to defend our progressive champions in Congress. But we do need enough resources to make sure the voices of our candidates aren’t drowned out by right-wing attacks. It’s no surprise that AIPAC is sweating. Just over the last few weeks, they have: Lost in their first foray into Democratic primaries in a Congressional race in California, despite spending over $5 million on attack ads,1 Seen over 20 organizations including WFP join together and urge Democratic candidates and officials to Reject AIPAC, in an unprecedented coalition effort,2 Had embarrassing documents leaked that show they are urging candidates and surrogates to lie about the severity of the humanitarian crisis in Gaza,3 Watched as their brand has become increasingly toxic, and Democratic leaders start to break with Prime Minister Netanyahu, even as they wholeheartedly embrace him and his horrific policies.4 The Republican billionaires who fund AIPAC may claim they are focused only on one issue. But here’s what they really want: They want to elect Republicans in swing seats and conservative Democrats in safe ones. They want to drag the whole country to the right on issues from healthcare to climate change, from the minimum wage to student debt. And they want to put insurrectionist Republicans, MAGA, and Trump back in full control of the levers of power in Washington, D.C. We can’t let any of that happen. And that starts with defending our own Congressional champions in primaries that kick off next month. In solidarity, Team WFP Sources: 1\. , The Guardian, March 11, 2024 2\. , The Intercept, March 11, 2024 3\. , Rolling Stone, March 14, 2024 4\. , The Associated Press, March 14, 2024 Thoughts? I wanted to send a quick email to make sure you know how important you are to my campaign.

The Portland area has seen much better times, and the current District Attorney is a big reason why.

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/ffeb14ae2b90/we-need-to-talk-about-portland?e=ffb5e20bef)

** We need to talk about Portland
------------------------------------------------------------

A friend referred you over to us as someone who cares about Oregon. Since you may not have known that this email is coming, you can opt out here (https://voteforvasquez.us12.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=2859120a283c12ca5aac18412&id=7649895bc1&utm_source=Vote+Vasquez+2024&utm_campaign=3246facab5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_12_04_46&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-3246facab5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) if you’d rather not hear about this critical race.

If you care about Oregon, however, you probably know that Multnomah County (the county which is almost entirely simply the city of Portland) is at a crossroads. The current District Attorney Mike Schmidt has overseen perhaps the most dramatic increase of both violent and property crime in our county’s history since his election in 2020. Drug dealers have routinely gone unprosecuted, which has played a major part in Measure 110 being the disaster that it’s been. He has completely alienated law enforcement and irreparably harmed that vital working relationship. His form of “restorative justice’ has repeatedly led to violent criminals being released back onto the street with little or no bail.

In short: when you hear bad things about Portland in the news, Schmidt’s policies have played a major role.
Learn About Nathan Vasquez (https://www.voteforvasquez.com/?utm_source=Vote+Vasquez+2024&utm_campaign=3246facab5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_12_04_46&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-3246facab5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Nathan Vasquez is running to be Multnomah County’s next District Attorney, and the election is in May. He is the Senior Deputy right under Schmidt, but unlike Schmidt he has over two decades of prosecutorial experience where he has prosecuted some of the most violent crimes in the county.

Vasquez knows that the “catch and release” policies of Schmidt make all of us feel unsafe. As our next DA he will prioritize prosecuting drug dealers and ending open-air drug use, enforce failures to appear in court, and repair frayed relationships with law enforcement. Last and perhaps most importantly, he has a six point plan to help us recover from the disaster that is Measure 110. You can find his full plan here (https://www.voteforvasquez.com/platform?utm_source=Vote+Vasquez+2024&utm_campaign=3246facab5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_12_04_46&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-3246facab5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

If you agree that this is the change we need, then Nathan needs your help. We know that billionaire out-of-state donors will come to Schmidt’s side like they did in 2020. Can you help us fight back with a donation today (https://www.cesystems.tech/campaign/vasquezvotevasquez/?referral=email-3-12&utm_source=Vote+Vasquez+2024&utm_campaign=3246facab5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_12_04_46&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-3246facab5-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) ?

Please donate today and help Nathan Vasquez turn Multnomah County around.

Hi Friend, it's Sen. Brad Pfaff. **Wisconsin’s legislative session ended this week.** **This means that after fighting hard all year for Wisconsin’s farmers and working families, I’m officially turning my focus towards running my people–powered reelection campaign.** Before I tell you a little more about it, I’m going to be honest:**_this is going to be a tough race against an extremely well funded far–right opponent._** [**Friend, I’m counting on our community’s support to cross the finish line in November – can I count on you to stand with me by making a donation of any amount today?**](https://bp4wi.us/l/s8nnt8jh3o8L)
---
[ **SUPPORT BRAD** ](https://bp4wi.us/l/ikE1PaYBfAJ5)
---
| [ ](https://bp4wi.us/l/Xw28SX35v2UO)
---
In the past 4 years, I’ve introduced or co-sponsored bills that would: ☑️Cap the cost of insulin at $35 because nobody should be forced to ration their medication ☑️Provide property tax relief for working Wisconsinites ☑️Create a food security grant program because no Wisconsinite should go hungry ☑️Clean toxic PFAS chemicals from our groundwater based on science–backed standards and establish new grant programs to help homeowners clean PFAS from their water ☑️Establish a pathway for high–performing Wisconsin high school students to gain automatic admission to prestigious universities such as UW–Madison and UW–La Crosse so we can retain young talent. **But there's so much more to do – and I need your help to win this race.** **[Friend, let’s work together towards creating a better future for all Wisconsinites, starting by winning this district. | Peter, in just a minute I’ll ask you to [_**split a contribution between my campaign and Fight for Progress ahead of our mid-month fundraising deadline**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/81037623/461185431/665036969?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-03-15_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjY4OTA2ODlmLWZlZTItZWUxMS1hYWYwLTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=aHLKh-FU4P4zhNDzjPyzkOAPoQ_RD1iHvRrrhntX0S0=), but first I hope you’ll give me a moment to explain why it’s so important to give—especially today.

I grew up on my family’s farm, and Sharla and I still work that land today. In my opinion, being a farmer makes me a better senator. My background is a big part of the reason I remain grounded and focused on defending our Montana way of life. Because with all the chaos in Washington (especially now), you need somebody who will roll up their sleeves and get to work.

It was another session where special interests were put ahead of Hoosiers. The GOP supermajority attacked local control, including by overturning local ordinances in 21 cities banning puppy mills. Instead of addressing the rural healthcare crisis and a growing OB GYN shortage, the Republican supermajority passed a law to allow Diego Morales and Todd Rokita to carry a handgun in the Statehouse. They also gutted the power of the public access counselor, blocked an end to the tampon tax, and defunded Indiana’s gaming police. Breaking the supermajority this fall is our way to get more common sense legislation passed, stop bad proposals, and restore balance to our politics. **** _Top Five Republican Candidates For Governor Against Ballot Referendums_ The top candidates running for the Republican nomination for governor all came out against ballot referendums in Indiana this week at the GOP debate in Carmel. While some tried to sidestep the question, all five reiterated that they wouldn’t advocate for a referendum process if elected governor. **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81040780/461192054/-1504566290?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlOGMzN2I0Zi0wM2UzLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Cmi4GMkNrExza3AHf78H0uI29Dm5w0_xUQ63MC03YYU=&emci=219fcf99-fbe2-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=e8c37b4f-03e3-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=4925535)**[ Share INDems](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81040781/461192055/-1504566290?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlOGMzN2I0Zi0wM2UzLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Cmi4GMkNrExza3AHf78H0uI29Dm5w0_xUQ63MC03YYU=&emci=219fcf99-fbe2-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&emdi=e8c37b4f-03e3-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=4925535) But it’s clear they feel the pressure. clean_body: | Welcome to the Indiana Democratic Party's weekly newsletter, The Kernel of Truth. The State Party will provide the most important fact - a kernel of truth - from the week. ** State Legislative Session Ends as Another Missed Opportunity For Hoosiers Last Friday, the Indiana General Assembly gaveled out for the final time in 2024, bringing the state legislative session to a close. It was another session where special interests were put ahead of Hoosiers. The GOP supermajority attacked local control, including by overturning local ordinances in 21 cities banning puppy mills. Instead of addressing the rural healthcare crisis and a growing OB GYN shortage, the Republican supermajority passed a law to allow Diego Morales and Todd Rokita to carry a handgun in the Statehouse. They also gutted the power of the public access counselor, blocked an end to the tampon tax, and defunded Indiana’s gaming police. Breaking the supermajority this fall is our way to get more common sense legislation passed, stop bad proposals, and restore balance to our politics. Top Five Republican Candidates For Governor Against Ballot Referendums The top candidates running for the Republican nomination for governor all came out against ballot referendums in Indiana this week at the GOP debate in Carmel. While some tried to sidestep the question, all five reiterated that they wouldn’t advocate for a referendum process if elected governor. But it’s clear they feel the pressure. Even Mike Braun noted the disconnect between abortion policy in Ohio and the referendum results. Hoosiers are putting pressure on their legislators on this issue – breaking the supermajority and electing Jennifer McCormick as our next governor is the fastest way to a referendum process in Indiana. Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. We’ve previously featured Senator Rodney Pol, Jr’s (Chesterton) bill to mandate life rings on Lake Michigan beaches. We’re happy to report that this legislation was signed into law by Governor Holcomb this week. This is a win for public safety — Indiana’s beaches are beautiful, but they’re dangerous. body:
They’re trying to ruin a great man...

Dear Friend,

They're trying to ruin a great man...

Between the anger and tears, that's what keeps going through my mind when I think about the unfair attacks on my hero police officer husband, Mark Wagner, as his trial date quickly approaches on March 18th.
[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/0ww-Bl8PJPC2Q349stMsdQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRn10BEP0SWaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi8zZGNiYWUzYS02MWRlLTRjM2YtYjNlYS03YzVkMTEzODEyYjY_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzE1X0JER19MRUxERl9XQUcyX1JFTl9QQS1VU0NOVwNzcGNCCmXvjqX0ZUlMcctSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)
That's Mark in the picture I sent you, along with our boys Nolan and Jacob and dog Kilo.

Not only is Mark a highly respected officer, he's an incredibly supportive father, a loving husband, and a fierce friend.

But Mark worked in far-Left Madison, Wisconsin - and the "defund the police" mob whipped up rage and smeared Mark as a racist. The corrupt media repeatedly LIED about Mark to trash his reputation.

Now Mark faces 10 YEARS behind bars for doing exactly what he was trained to do in the line of duty - and I'm scared I might lose him. **[That's why I wrote this letter to you, someone I've never met before, to ask for your help.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/0ww-Bl8PJPC2Q349stMsdQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRn10BEP0SWaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi8zZGNiYWUzYS02MWRlLTRjM2YtYjNlYS03YzVkMTEzODEyYjY_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzE1X0JER19MRUxERl9XQUcyX1JFTl9QQS1VU0NOVwNzcGNCCmXvjqX0ZUlMcctSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)**

But first, please let me explain what happened...

On the morning of February 3, 2022, Mark and other officers tried to arrest a _violent_ _criminal_ named Quadren Wilson.

Wilson has a rap sheet a mile long with dozens of arrests for drug distribution, theft, witness intimidation, battery, eluding police, and more. He was wanted for dealing fentanyl to a man found dead in a restaurant bathroom.

Mark's arrest team had a plan in place to capture the suspect in his vehicle. So they pulled in their trucks to block his car on both ends. But he floored the accelerator, spinning his wheels wildly in a desperate attempt to escape.

My husband and another officer exited their vehicle. Mark was holding one of those big POLICE shields and had his gun drawn. But the suspect refused Mark's commands to show his hands.

With the wheels screeching and smoking, Mark and the other officer saw the suspect reach into the center console and pull his hand up.

Mark thought the suspect had a gun. He heard what he thought was gunfire and felt something hit his shield and push him backward.

**Both Mark and the other officer responded to this life-threatening situation by firing into the vehicle.**

Thankfully, the suspect survived and no one else was injured. But because he is black and Mark is white - anti-police radicals jumped at the chance to target my husband.

Protesters drummed up a racial firestorm by spreading lies that the suspect "had his hands up" and that he "was shot five times in the back." The corrupt liberal media repeated these lies and painted my husband as a monster.

Then on September 22, 2022, the liberal District Attorney caved to the mob and filed BOGUS felony charges against Mark. **Now Mark faces 10 YEARS in prison. His trial is scheduled to begin on March 18th.**

**[Now I hope you can see why I'm turning to you for help today.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/0ww-Bl8PJPC2Q349stMsdQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRn10BEP0SWaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi8zZGNiYWUzYS02MWRlLTRjM2YtYjNlYS03YzVkMTEzODEyYjY_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzE1X0JER19MRUxERl9XQUcyX1JFTl9QQS1VU0NOVwNzcGNCCmXvjqX0ZUlMcctSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)**

Mark dedicated his life to helping others. He's spent 30 years in law enforcement, most of them with the Milwaukee Police Department (MPD).

We knew fighting alone against the anti-police movement here in Wisconsin would be impossible and our hope that justice would prevail was quickly fading when we received a call from **the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF)** offering to help Mark.

This incredible organization helps innocent officers, like my husband, who have been unfairly prosecuted for split-second, use-of-force decisions in the line of duty.

Law and justice experts like President Ronald Reagan's Attorney General Edwin Meese and former FBI Assistant Director Ronald Hosko serve on LELDF's Board. LELDF's president, Jason Johnson, served over 20 years as a police officer, including as Deputy Commissioner of the Baltimore Police Department.

In short, these are experts when it comes to policing. And they thoroughly vet cases to determine if an officer was wrongly accused or charged before deciding to help.

They provide legal counsel, expert witnesses, whatever is needed to make sure wrongly accused police officers get a fair shake in court. And they do it all free of charge!

But LELDF doesn't receive any money from the government to help police officers facing unjust charges. They're funded entirely by the generous support of folks like you who can recognize a miscarriage of justice and want to help fix it.

Now I must ask if you're one of those people...

**[Will you please help my husband Mark fight to clear his name by rushing a generous, tax-deductible donation to LELDF today?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/0ww-Bl8PJPC2Q349stMsdQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRn10BEP0SWaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi8zZGNiYWUzYS02MWRlLTRjM2YtYjNlYS03YzVkMTEzODEyYjY_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzE1X0JER19MRUxERl9XQUcyX1JFTl9QQS1VU0NOVwNzcGNCCmXvjqX0ZUlMcctSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)**

Your kind gift today of $35, $50, or $100 to help Mark will mean so much to my family.

Or, if you're blessed with the means to help with a gift of $250, $500, or even $1,000 or more, I pray you will so my husband doesn't spend the next 10 YEARS behind bars away from our family.

With the trial just around the corner, there is no time to waste. **[So please follow this link to make your tax-deductible donation right away.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/0ww-Bl8PJPC2Q349stMsdQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRn10BEP0SWaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi8zZGNiYWUzYS02MWRlLTRjM2YtYjNlYS03YzVkMTEzODEyYjY_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzE1X0JER19MRUxERl9XQUcyX1JFTl9QQS1VU0NOVwNzcGNCCmXvjqX0ZUlMcctSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)**

Any gift amount you can give today is truly a blessing. No matter what, please say a prayer for Mark and our family.

Thank you in advance for your generous support of my family and LELDF.

With deepest gratitude,
Becky Wagner

P.S. This is the type of man the anti-police mob is targeting and trying to destroy: a kidney donor, a youth football coach, a man who assists the elderly from our parish in running errands and doing handy-man projects. A man of faith who's always helping others.

Mark faces 10 years behind bars - simply for doing his job to serve and protect. And is trial is scheduled to begin soon on March 18th. **[Will you help him clear his name by making a tax-deductible donation of $35, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund today?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/0ww-Bl8PJPC2Q349stMsdQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRn10BEP0SWaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi8zZGNiYWUzYS02MWRlLTRjM2YtYjNlYS03YzVkMTEzODEyYjY_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzE1X0JER19MRUxERl9XQUcyX1JFTl9QQS1VU0NOVwNzcGNCCmXvjqX0ZUlMcctSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)** Your generosity will help LELDF mount the strongest legal defenses for my husband and other wrongly accused officers. Thank you in advance for your prayers and support.
--------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we 're defending, please visit **www.PoliceDefense.org**. And remember -Blue Lives Matter!_
