Not only is Mark a highly respected officer, he's an incredibly supportive father, a loving husband, and a fierce friend. But Mark worked in far-Left Madison, Wisconsin - and the "defund the police" mob whipped up rage and smeared Mark as a racist. The corrupt media repeatedly LIED about Mark to trash his reputation. Now Mark faces 10 YEARS behind bars for doing exactly what he was trained to do in the line of duty - and I'm scared I might lose him. But first, please let me explain what happened... On the morning of February 3, 2022, Mark and other officers tried to arrest a violent criminal named Quadren Wilson. Wilson has a rap sheet a mile long with dozens of arrests for drug distribution, theft, witness intimidation, battery, eluding police, and more. He was wanted for dealing fentanyl to a man found dead in a restaurant bathroom. Mark's arrest team had a plan in place to capture the suspect in his vehicle. So they pulled in their trucks to block his car on both ends. But he floored the accelerator, spinning his wheels wildly in a desperate attempt to escape. My husband and another officer exited their vehicle. Mark was holding one of those big POLICE shields and had his gun drawn. But the suspect refused Mark's commands to show his hands. With the wheels screeching and smoking, Mark and the other officer saw the suspect reach into the center console and pull his hand up. Mark thought the suspect had a gun. He heard what he thought was gunfire and felt something hit his shield and push him backward. Both Mark and the other officer responded to this life-threatening situation by firing into the vehicle. Thankfully, the suspect survived and no one else was injured. But because he is black and Mark is white - anti-police radicals jumped at the chance to target my husband. Protesters drummed up a racial firestorm by spreading lies that the suspect "had his hands up" and that he "was shot five times in the back." The corrupt liberal media repeated these lies and painted my husband as a monster. Then on September 22, 2022, the liberal District Attorney caved to the mob and filed BOGUS felony charges against Mark. Now Mark faces 10 YEARS in prison. His trial is scheduled to begin on March 18th. Mark dedicated his life to helping others. He's spent 30 years in law enforcement, most of them with the Milwaukee Police Department (MPD). We knew fighting alone against the anti-police movement here in Wisconsin would be impossible and our hope that justice would prevail was quickly fading when we received a call from the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF) offering to help Mark. This incredible organization helps innocent officers, like my husband, who have been unfairly prosecuted for split-second, use-of-force decisions in the line of duty. Law and justice experts like President Ronald Reagan's Attorney General Edwin Meese and former FBI Assistant Director Ronald Hosko serve on LELDF's Board. LELDF's president, Jason Johnson, served over 20 years as a police officer, including as Deputy Commissioner of the Baltimore Police Department. In short, these are experts when it comes to policing. And they thoroughly vet cases to determine if an officer was wrongly accused or charged before deciding to help. They provide legal counsel, expert witnesses, whatever is needed to make sure wrongly accused police officers get a fair shake in court. And they do it all free of charge! But LELDF doesn't receive any money from the government to help police officers facing unjust charges. They're funded entirely by the generous support of folks like you who can recognize a miscarriage of justice and want to help fix it. Now I must ask if you're one of those people... Your kind gift today of $35, $50, or $100 to help Mark will mean so much to my family. Or, if you're blessed with the means to help with a gift of $250, $500, or even $1,000 or more, I pray you will so my husband doesn't spend the next 10 YEARS behind bars away from our family. With the trial just around the corner, there is no time to waste. Any gift amount you can give today is truly a blessing. No matter what, please say a prayer for Mark and our family. Thank you in advance for your generous support of my family and LELDF. With deepest gratitude, Becky Wagner P.S. This is the type of man the anti-police mob is targeting and trying to destroy: a kidney donor, a youth football coach, a man who assists the elderly from our parish in running errands and doing handy-man projects. A man of faith who's always helping others. Mark faces 10 years behind bars - simply for doing his job to serve and protect. And is trial is scheduled to begin soon on March 18th. Your generosity will help LELDF mount the strongest legal defenses for my husband and other wrongly accused officers. Thank you in advance for your prayers and support. More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we 're defending, please visit www.PoliceDefense.org. And remember -Blue Lives Matter! _**“We all breathe the same air. We all cherish our children's future. And we are all mortal.”**_
– President John F. Kennedy, 1963
President Kennedy’s timeless wisdom remains relevant – particularly when it comes to combating climate change.

Last night, I was fortunate to participate in a community forum hosted by the Citizens’ Climate Lobby (York and Harrisburg chapters) and the Unitarian Universalist Congregation of York. We discussed the increasing threat of climate disaster and the urgent need for our elected officials to address this crisis.

While President Biden and Democrats in Congress have made historic progress by investing in climate action – progress that I believe we can take even further so that the U.S. becomes a true leader in the global effort against climate change – Scott Perry obstructs this work at every turn.

**We all have a shared responsibility to participate in community-led efforts to help solve our climate crisis. I have spent my career building bipartisan coalitions and engaging with the entire commUNITY, the exact approach needed to preserve a livable planet for our children.**

[I’m ready to bring this work to Congress. The climate crisis demands immediate action.

If Scott Perry and the MAGA Republicans succeed in their anti-climate agenda, our future is bleak. Millions of people along America’s coastlines and in America’s heartland will be displaced. The victims of climate change – ordinary Americans like you and me – stand to lose everything we’ve worked for our whole lives.

Around the world, the same thing will happen to billions more, causing mass migrations. The collapse of natural systems like the Gulf Stream will dramatically change weather systems and the climate humans rely on for food. The humanitarian crisis will be beyond comprehension.

Putting aside political games and working together is the only way forward. We can avoid climate catastrophe, and America can become a global leader in sustainable energy and new technologies that create millions of new, high-paying union jobs. Solar and wind energy alone have already created hundreds of thousands of jobs in the electrical trades. Re-building our electric grid will create even more.

[No matter how you look at it, Scott Perry’s future world is far worse than ours. body:
Last week, I joined Andrea Mitchell on MSNBC to discuss the need to defend our reproductive rights.

| Peter,

**Last week, I joined Andrea Mitchell on MSNBC to discuss the need to defend our reproductive rights.**
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81043947/461197936/1993432125?refcode=BLU_EM_ASFG_2024-03-15_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDM4NTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWYyNDlhNDgtMDdlMy1lZTExLWFhZjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=7tMMFosNVkqPZrWhNusNMtbrYXnc0tIPKYARi5WIJN8=)
As President Biden said in his State of the Union address, women are not without electoral or political power, and we saw the direct results of this when the future of reproductive rights was on the ballot in 2022 across the country and in 2023 in Virginia’s legislative races.

Millions of American women continue to face threats to their fundamental rights following the _Dobbs_ decision.

In Alabama, we saw just how quickly our rights can be further attacked — not just the rights to abortion and contraception but also the right to access IVF.

Did you know that despite accounting for over 50% of the population, women make up just 29% of the current Congress? **And without equal representation, women have to work _that_ much harder to be heard – especially with the far right determined to roll back even more rights. This Women’s History Month, Team Dean is fighting back.**

I’m proud to stand with a staunch advocate for women’s rights. Mad is working to defend vulnerable seats for women across the country while also expanding their numbers for the next Congress. [**If you support his work and if you’re able, please consider chipping in to help us hit our $5,000 goal to defend Mad’s seat _and_ increase the number of women in Congress.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81044476/461199477/-2097766013?amount=25&refcode=03152024_md_mmfr_fr_3&refcode2=e567b400-08e3-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNTY3YjQwMC0wOGUzLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FXuRYOn9FKFdrAvnRn1zvn9ZbVQbix6YuKlscX-yUds=)

— Cole **Begin forwarded message:**
> Hello Peter,
>
> It’s Women’s History Month, but this year, beyond lifting inspirational women and their achievements, I want to highlight recent inequities and threats to women’s rights.
>
> Fundamental protections that women won in my lifetime are in peril thanks in part to the far-right contingent in Congress – a contingent that is increasingly detached from the needs of the American people. Here’s the truth, Peter: I don’t like all the money in politics. That’s why I’ve supported campaign finance reform and really appreciate grassroots donors — so there can be less BIG money in politics. And, despite this, I still need to raise money. Stuff isn’t free, and it takes resources to communicate all the good work we’re doing. It takes resources to reach folks where they’re at, especially online and on social media. We need money to break through and spread our message far and wide across Oregon. That’s how my team and I win support for policies and initiatives, talk to voters about the issues, and share our wins with the people of the state. That’s why this ask is important, Peter. name: Joe Kent
subject: Know what I find ironic?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Joe Kent Victory Fund
body:
Dear Patriot,
I am Joe Kent, your Republican candidate for Congress in Washington's 3rd District. I am also a Green Beret combat veteran and a Gold Star husband.
_My life experiences mean that I have a lot to say about what is going on in America right now._
I have seen war firsthand, and I have lost my life partner in an entirely unnecessary way.
_When I dream of America 's future, I dream of a land that is safe and free for my children and yours._
**And right now, all signs point to the destruction and deterioration of every aspect of our freedom, peace, and safety.**
_A big part of that destruction is being brought on by the fentanyl crisis that is creeping in through our southern border._
_What I find really ironic about this is that my far-left opponent, Marie Perez, is patting herself on the shoulder for being a part of the "End Fentanyl" Act that she's trying to pass right now._
On one hand, she is finally acknowledging that our communities are being destroyed by Fentanyl.
And on the other hand, this bill is nothing but empty words and shallow solutions.
**You see, Marie has apparently forgotten that she VOTED to let Fentanyl into our country in the first place.**
She forgot that she said, _" No one loses sleep over the southern border,"_ as our neighbors were being killed as the result of her and Biden's policies!
**Of course, now that it 's the big election year, she's suddenly changing her tune and acting tough on Fentanyl - BUT REFUSES TO SECURE THE BORDER.**
This is completely illogical and will not fool Washingtonians for much longer. But that does not mean Marie won't keep trying to spin her tales and weave her lies.
_But I am clear-eyed and am focused ever ahead to our future. And our future is grim if we subscribe to the America of Marie and Biden 's dreams._
Will you join me in opposing this team of clowns and getting our beloved nation back on track again?
**If so, please send $25, $50, or $75 today at**[https://JoeKentforCongress.com/](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/3qhzVhE8923e3MTyccvkuFfQ/C1mj763KCuy52Zjn7c0XHBXg)**. That will keep me going over the next few weeks as I continue to campaign hard and make sure our message gets out to every voter in District 3! If you can send more - $250, $500, or even $750, we will certainly sweep through to our victory!**
Washingtonians are tired of Marie's lies, and I am here to expose them, tell the truth, and then push for REAL solutions.
I am experienced and ready to roll. And I'm doing it for the next generation.
I hope you will join me. I am grateful for your time and generosity!
God bless,
Joe Kent
Republican Candidate for Congress (WA-03)
Former Special Forces Operator
America First Conservative
Paid for by the Joe Kent Victory Fund

clean_body: | = Aloha Peter, As the first Asian American woman elected to the Senate — and the only immigrant currently serving in the chamber — I know how important it is to speak out against injustice. Before I explain more below, can you add a donation before tonight’s mid-month fundraising deadline? Here’s a personal link to give:= For most of my career, I engaged in this work stolidly and without much fuss. In the cultures I was raised in, we were not rewarded for speaking up, or speaking out. So I focused on doing the work, and letting the work speak for itself. This led many to say, when I began speaking out about the awful actions by the Trump Administration, and the awful behavior by Trump himself, that I had “found my voice.” This could not be further from the truth. I chose to use my voice. I couldn’t stand by while the Trump administration ripped children out of the arms of their parents, incited white supremacists, and packed the nation’s courts with demagogues who would later overturn Roe v. Wade. His bullying behavior, and his interest in tearing our country apart by our differences, instead of investing in the diversity that makes us stronger, had to be called out. This interest in exposing our differences was never limited to Donald Trump. This is the GOP’s agenda. It was there in the way they embraced calling COVID-19 “the China virus,” it was there when they spoke out against President Biden’s intention to nominate a Black woman to the Supreme Court, and it is still there now, as Republican legislatures across the country ban books that tell diverse, welcoming stories for minority and LGBTQ+ communities. As long as Republicans — whether in the House, the Senate, or the supermajority of right wing ideologues on the Supreme Court — continue to try to tear us apart, I will continue to speak out bluntly about the danger they pose to women, the LGTBQ+ community, immigrants, and other vulnerable groups. Peter, I cannot do this work alone. My work has always been powered by grassroots supporters like you,and I wouldn't have it any other way. = | | | **= ** | **= ** | | **= ** | **= ** | | **= ** | **= ** Thank you for reading and for supporting my work today. subject: Join our March Statewide Call

body:
We're talking about candidates

| | [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=JgyyvCfQwldlSeD7KJl_Ih7269o_4hwqOhPs1_PHvgI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240318_statewide_call&n=1)
---
Friday, March 15, 2024 | Peter --
#### **March Statewide Call**
Please join us Monday March 18th at 8pm for our Monthly Statewide Call. We're discussing candidates this month. Volunteers from states around the country, including our very own Ben Valimont, recently embarked on the creation of a new National Candidate Pledge. What does that pledge cover and what does it mean when a candidate says they want to work with us? What do we mean when we say we're looking for candidates? Let's talk about it together. [](https://home.forwardparty.com/pa_fwd_march_statewide_meeting_20240318?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240318_statewide_call&n=2)
* * *
#### **Would you make a good candidate?**
There's also an important deadline coming for anyone thinking of running for office this year as an independent or 3rd party candidate. You have about a week to change your voter registration to make yourself eligible. We want candidates to run against uncontested state house members. To see if your house race is uncontested, use these 2 links. 1\. [Click here to Find your district.](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=r7-yZpJYUvZfHwJd04CgS_0aZ5ilYcD1nBiXPZBiJvN6NZTxeDeCyYMLc2p0LwfqihJp9FSPm9A8cFQSGtkomcofjz99NiICquJ4si4sXYI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240318_statewide_call&n=3) 2\. [Click here to look up the candidates in each district.](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=N-ZescOAqg88fULNXku0buO7wvHMzu5LaEqbsXcrIuc4EQAedjh2QgfdpHGzn-5-um88OabinO6K_Iyq7MNmcWgI8gV7uRGri1cJgizGFBU&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240318_statewide_call&n=4) If there are only candidates from one party listed, your district will not have a choice this November. We'd love to talk to you about giving them one. Just reply to this email.
* * *
#### **Candidate Launch Event**
We're of course also talking about our candidate Launch events on 3/26. over 90% of the people getting this invite will be within 50 miles of a major event that day so we'd love it if you'd come on out and show your support. [](https://home.forwardparty.com/20240326_pa_candidate_launch?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240318_statewide_call&n=5) We at the Pennsylvania Forward Party are proud to introduce **two very exciting people**. They will represent the Pennsylvania Forward this year as **candidates for statewide office**. You'll hear a lot more about these candidates from us, Forward National, and hopefully, from your local sources of Pennsylvania news over the next few months. Help us get these candidates off to the best possible start by **attending one or more of the launch events on Tuesday, March 26 th, to meet them in person.** These announcements are also a great moment for the National Forward Party. Pennsylvania is one of the key states with opportunities to put Forwardists in office. We'll be joined by **big-name guests from National Forward Leadership and Partnered office holders**. | [](https://home.forwardparty.com/20240326_pa_candidate_launch?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240318_statewide_call&n=6 "Launch Information") [Launch Information](https://home.forwardparty.com/20240326_pa_candidate_launch?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240318_statewide_call&n=6)
---
The March 26th **Launch Forward Day** will include **3 separate events**. The two morning events will be in **Pittsburgh at 9:30 am** and in **Philadelphia at 10 am**. Attendees from these two announcements will then journey to **Harrisburg at 2:30 pm** for a joint candidate announcement. We encourage everyone to join us at their local Candidate Announcement in the morning and join us in Harrisburg in the afternoon (if able)!
Please RSVP for an event so we can keep you up to date on details as we can release them by clicking on the links below.
* #### [Pittsburgh, 9:30 am](https://home.forwardparty.com/20240326_launch_pittsburgh?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240318_statewide_call&n=7)
* #### [Philadelphia, 10 am](https://home.forwardparty.com/20240326_launch_philadelphia?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240318_statewide_call&n=8)
* #### [Harrisburg, 2:30 pm](https://home.forwardparty.com/20240326_launch_harrisburg?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240318_statewide_call&n=9)

| | | **Support Our Future Leaders on National Girl Scout Day****!**
---

Dear Peter,
On National Girl Scout Day, we celebrated the incredible impact of Girl Scouts in Washington's 8th district and across the nation. These young leaders are at the forefront of creating positive change through community service, developing innovative projects, and learning invaluable life skills. The Girl Scouts are not just preparing cookies; they're preparing to shape the future.

Carmen Goers is committed to fostering a world where every girl has the opportunity to become a leader who makes a difference. By supporting equal opportunities for girls and protecting their rights, Carmen’s campaign is dedicated to ensuring the bright futures of these aspiring leaders.

---
| | | |
---
|
In honor of National Girl Scout Day, we invite you to make a special contribution to Carmen's campaign.

Your donation of $25, $50, or even $100 will help Carmen advocate for policies that support youth leadership development and empower the next generation of women leaders..

---

Thank you for your support and for believing in the power of our future leaders.

Sincerely,

Carmen Goers

body:
It's green season: St. Patrick's Day, green light to my candidacy, and asking for money (because I'm a candidate) | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/c7aa860c060e/the-luck-of-the-candidate?e=3d27610f3d)
---
| |
## Chasing the Rainbow
The signs of spring are all around us. The cardinals and blue jays that call my backyard home are busily going about their routines, while the roses come into bloom and the dogwoods blaze brightly in the woods.

The beginning of spring is one of my favorite times of year. Everything and everybody begins to wake up and shed the winter slumber. It is a time of energy, a time of growth, and a time for looking ahead to the things to come. Nowhere has that been more true than here at the campaign.

During the first week of the month, March 7th specifically, I qualified as a candidate for the United States House of Representatives in Georgia's newly drawn 7th district. It's official folks! The race is on! And, it is on to November, as I did not draw a primary opponent.

Last week, my team and I focused on the nitty-gritty background work that form the infrastructure of any good campaign. I am proud to let you know that the website: christianforga7.com is up and running and I encourage y'all to check it out.

Another exciting development is we have established and will soon be launching our texting campaign. The goal is to give us a tool to update our supporters in real time about key events or critical moments in the campaign. Keep an eye on your phones over the course of the next week.

Spring is also a time when people turn their eye to fashion, so I am pleased to let you know that we will be receiving our first shipment of what I am sure will be the hottest fashion item of the season - Bob Christian for Congress t-shirts are on the way! These are going to go fast, folks, so stop by any of the public appearances listed below, and grab yours soon.

Finally, all through these first two weeks of March I was able to continue visiting with and meeting Democrats across the district. Forsyth County's monthly breakfast saw a packed room with nearly a dozen new faces. I met a very passionate and focused group of Democrats in Lumpkin County. In Dawson County, I had the honor of witnessing the first Democrat in over two decades register as a candidate for County Commission. And, to top it all off, I was recently named the 1st Vice-Chair for the District Committee.

As you can see, it has been a busy couple of weeks, and this is just the beginning folks. Time flies, and there is very little time to rest on the campaign trail, so over the course of the next two weeks you will start to see a lot more of me out and about while I continue to visit people around the district to let them teach me how to be their Representative. I look forward to meeting all of you.

In closing, I want to say thank you. Thank you to my supporters, thank you to my team, thank you to my family. Without all of you none of this would have been possible. Through your dedication and generosity we have come far and will go further still. All the way to Washington D.C.!

---
| | |
---
**SB 233 - School Vouchers** \- This bill just cleared the GA House and is now one step away from moving to the Governor's desk. We have one last chance to voice our displeasure. Please, call your State Senator and let them know we need kill this bill and continue to support a strong public education.

**Supreme Court -** SOTUS will be hearing oral arguments for several high profile cases, including the mifepristone injunction this month and the Trump immunity claim next month. This is not a call to action, per se, but more a call to be aware. The court has an excellent website at supremecourt.gov.

**Sine Die -** The final day of the Georgia legislative session is coming up on March 28. Be prepared for a flurry of news and calls to action as the legislature wraps up 40 days of incredibly hard work. The best sources of information on developments is usually your favorite Representative or Senator's newsletter. If you are not signed up for one, I encourage you to do so.

The beginning of spring is one of my favorite times of year. Everything and everybody begins to wake up and shed the winter slumber. It is a time of energy, a time of growth, and a time for looking ahead to the things to come. Nowhere has that been more true than here at the campaign. During the first week of the month, March 7th specifically, I qualified as a candidate for the United States House of Representatives in Georgia's newly drawn 7th district. It's official folks! The race is on! And, it is on to November, as I did not draw a primary opponent. Last week, my team and I focused on the nitty-gritty background work that form the infrastructure of any good campaign. I am proud to let you know that the website: christianforga7.com is up and running and I encourage y'all to check it out. Another exciting development is we have established and will soon be launching our texting campaign. The goal is to give us a tool to update our supporters in real time about key events or critical moments in the campaign. Keep an eye on your phones over the course of the next week. Spring is also a time when people turn their eye to fashion, so I am pleased to let you know that we will be receiving our first shipment of what I am sure will be the hottest fashion item of the season - Bob Christian for Congress t-shirts are on the way! These are going to go fast, folks, so stop by any of the public appearances listed below, and grab yours soon. Finally, all through these first two weeks of March I was able to continue visiting with and meeting Democrats across the district. Forsyth County's monthly breakfast saw a packed room with nearly a dozen new faces. I met a very passionate and focused group of Democrats in Lumpkin County. In Dawson County, I had the honor of witnessing the first Democrat in over two decades register as a candidate for County Commission. And, to top it all off, I was recently named the 1st Vice-Chair for the District Committee. As you can see, it has been a busy couple of weeks, and this is just the beginning folks. Time flies, and there is very little time to rest on the campaign trail, so over the course of the next two weeks you will start to see a lot more of me out and about while I continue to visit people around the district to let them teach me how to be their Representative. I look forward to meeting all of you. In closing, I want to say thank you. Thank you to my supporters, thank you to my team, thank you to my family. Without all of you none of this would have been possible. Through your dedication and generosity we have come far and will go further still. All the way to Washington D.C.! | | | SB 233 - School Vouchers \- This bill just cleared the GA House and is now one step away from moving to the Governor's desk. We have one last chance to voice our displeasure. Please, call your State Senator and let them know we need kill this bill and continue to support a strong public education. Supreme Court - SOTUS will be hearing oral arguments for several high profile cases, including the mifepristone injunction this month and the Trump immunity claim next month. This is not a call to action, per se, but more a call to be aware. The court has an excellent website at supremecourt.gov. Sine Die - The final day of the Georgia legislative session is coming up on March 28. Be prepared for a flurry of news and calls to action as the legislature wraps up 40 days of incredibly hard work. The best sources of information on developments is usually your favorite Representative or Senator's newsletter. If you are not signed up for one, I encourage you to do so. | | Saturday, March 16 - Breakfast with Cherokee Dems - IHOP, Canton, GA Tuesday, March 19 - Beer with Bob live on TikTok, 6 - 6:30pm @christianforga7 (last week we set a campaign record with 1,138 viewers!) Saturday, March 23 - Politics Talk with the Cherokee Dems, Canton GA Sunday, March 24 - Forsyth County Town Hall featuring local, state, and federal candidates, 4 - 5:30pm, Sharon Forks Library Tuesday, March 26 - Beer with Bob live on TikTok, 6 - 6:30pm @christianforga7 Tuesday, March 26 - Drinks with Lumpkin County Democrats, Dahlonega, GA Thursday, March 28 - Forsyth County State of the County, Cumming, GA, 10:30am - 1:30pm. Thursday, March 28 \- Dinner with Cherokee Democrats, Canton, GA | | "Click to Contribute" | | | | | | | | | | | | Copyright © 2024 Christian For Congress, All rights reserved.

| | **A Note from CAPT Hung Cao USN (Ret)** President Joe Biden recently delivered his fourth and final State of the Union address full of shouting and lies, but you know what stood out to me during the speech? After his speech a Gold Star father whose son was killed during Biden’s withdrawal from Afghanistan was hauled out of the U.S. Capitol building while pro-Hamas protestors interfered with a presidential motorcade outside and faced no consequences. What has our country come to? America cannot afford four more years of this. We have the opportunity to build the America you want your children and grandchildren to grow up in if we elect leaders like myself who will put you and your family first. As I travel across the Commonwealth, I hear from families who are sick and tired of the Biden Administration’s continual failures and it inspires me to keep fighting for each and every one of you. As always, I am grateful for your continued support as we fight on! \- CAPT Hung Cao USN (Ret)

We just took a huge risk to go up with our first TV ads of this election... The money wasn’t in the budget, but our whole team agreed: We have to do everything we possibly can to defeat right-wing megamillionaire Eric Hovde and send Tammy back to the Senate so she can keep fighting for all of us. Please read Tammy’s message so you know why we had to make this difficult decision — **[and then chip in, if you can.](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-mar24.lt590f&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240315_PM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=2228%2E35263%2ESoa3GT)** \---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Tammy Baldwin
Date: Thu, Mar 7, 2024

For weeks, Eric Hovde has had the airwaves to himself — putting our campaign in a difficult position. **That’s why my campaign manager just gave the green light to increase our advertising budget for the month so we could launch our own TV and digital ads right away.** This was a tough decision to make. Look, TV ads aren’t cheap — they’re one of the most expensive line items on any campaign’s budget, but they’re also one of the most effective ways to win an election. That’s why I’m telling you all of this. The decision may have blown a hole in the budget, but I felt confident taking the risk because this grassroots team has always had my back. My hope is that I can count on you right now. **[Will you rush a donation to help our campaign close this unexpected budget gap so we can keep our ads up for as long as possible? body:
__Don 't miss this chance to TRIPLE your impact. |
---

| DEVELOPING -- unless Congress strikes a deal, major portions of the federal government will shut down a week from tomorrow.

Now, with only a few days remaining, we're getting word that MAGA extremists in Congress are working to force anti-environmental riders into the must-pass budget deal. These include:

**-- Blocking implementation of the Paris Climate Agreement
-- Eliminating the American Climate Corps
-- A _complete reversal_ of President Biden's executive actions to combat climate change.**

This is bad -- and we need to stop them. LCV's teams are on Capitol Hill _right now_ , meeting with members of Congress and their staff, and going toe-to-toe with Big Oil's army of lobbyists who are _flooding_ lawmakers with misinformation.

But the truth is that we need more resources to keep the pressure on legislators and keep our work going strong. _So, we 're asking:_

[Renew your LCV membership for $5 to power LCV's hard-hitting campaigns to protect our climate and our communities. Every gift will be TRIPLED for a limited time, so please don't wait -- renew now >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/mkyVH2733Gc-)

_Here 's where we stand right now -- can you confirm your status below?_

| | **
** **LCV SPRING MATCH CAMPAIGN**

**Supporter Record:** Peter Willis

**Deadline:** Sunday, March 31**
Fundraising Goal:** $50,000
**Progress to Goal:** 30%

**STATUS:** [Renew now -- it only takes $5 >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/mkyVH2733Gc-) |
---|---|---

That's not all, Peter. As this is happening, Republicans are also intensifying their campaign to force a MASSIVE build-out for liquefied methane gas (LNG) exports after the Biden administration moved to pause new project approvals in January.

The climate impact of allowing this fossil-fuel build-out to move forward would be _devastating_. A new analysis revealed that the lifecycle of LNG emissions would be just as harmful as burning coal -- and in some cases, it's even worse.

To give an example, the proposed CP2 gas export project in Louisiana -- if allowed to go forward -- would have yearly climate emissions equal to **53 coal-fired power plants or 43 million cars.**

Stopping LNG projects like this is critical -- but it will take resources to organize, mobilize, and pressure lawmakers that we just don't have right now. Can you help us close the gap?

[The best thing you can do for our planet _right now_ is to renew your LCV membership and power our hard-hitting environmental campaigns -- even $5 helps. Please, don't miss this chance to TRIPLE your impact >>](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/mkyVH2733Gc-)

I'm grateful for your support, Peter. Together, I know we can win this fight for people and our planet.

Onward,

Gene Karpinski

Friend,

America cannot handle another year of Democratic leadership. As it currently stands:

1\. President Biden is pushing through trillions in the House for socialist ‘Woke” programs.

2\. Our country continues to sink deeper into debt, which is causing inflation and the prices of goods to remain high.

3\. Democratic Congressmen like Steve Horsford continually vote to pass bills that are hurting Las Vegas residents and businesses, and crippling the American Dream.

Democratic leaders have had multiple chances these past few years to reject Biden’s socialist agenda and fight to keep the American Dream alive. Instead, they sold out to the D.C. elite to focus on winning re-election, and raising millions of dollars from outside groups and mega-donors like George Soros.

We don’t need more career politicians; we need leaders who will do their job and pass policies that benefit the American people. **That’s why we need to support proven conservative John Lee for Congress.**

As Mayor of North Las Vegas, John was able to promote economic growth, balance the budget, and work to keep living affordable for Las Vegas citizens, [_**all while going through an economic crisis.**_](https://johnleeforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=18876e295d2df144af23d05e5&id=0b4f10511b&e=91a702298f)
**He has a track record of what responsible leadership and strong conservative principles can do for Las Vegas, and for Nevadans across the state.**
Will you help John Lee fight to put our country and our state back on track and donate just $4 today? It will go a long way on the road to November!

| I’ve been in office a year now. I’ve not gone viral once–that’s by design. Every week that I show up to Washington, I bring all the energy I can muster to solve the biggest challenges facing our country, not gain the most likes on social media. I coined a phrase my first year: I’m bringing BORING back to Congress. Whether it’s pouring over reports from the Government Accountability Office or talking about FAA regulations, I’m here to do the work, the boring stuff.

As I settle in to watch floor speeches from my colleagues, at some point, it dawns on me...oh, this is not about problem-solving; this is about going viral later. Sometimes, I feel like the House of Representatives could actually have its own reality TV show–The Real House Members of Washington, DC.

The Congressional obsession with social media over solving problems doesn’t affect everyone. I have great colleagues on both sides of the aisle who are there to do the work, but there are fewer and fewer of us.

I continue to show up to do the work–supporting working families, championing our small businesses and local economies, and making sure our women and girls don’t have fewer rights than our grandmothers.

Not going viral has its costs, though—folks who grandstand make Big Money through their online fundraising. While I might not be a TikTok sensation, **the work I do in Congress is essential for good governance, and the ability to win my seat is essential for a good government majority.**

I may not have a viral Twitter presence, but I do have all of you (10,000+ of you, if you can believe it!) who have supported me from the beginning. Friend, when I was first thinking about launching this campaign last year I had no idea what to expect.

I knew I had some supporters from my congressional campaigns that I could count on, but beyond that it was a shot in the dark.

One thing I knew for sure was that whether this was a 2-way race, a 3-way race, a 27-way race, whatever — I was going to need the support of a huge grassroots team behind me. Over the last year we’ve built that team, with close to 150,000 individual donors.

And now we know: Sinema’s out. This race is a head-to-head between me and Kari Lake. And we've got to expand out that grassroots team and build a coalition here in Arizona that can defeat her.

I believe that we can. But I can’t do it alone. So today, I’m asking you, very humbly, to make a donation to my campaign.

[**Please, split a $5 or $10 donation between Fight for Reform to help them elect state and local Dems and my campaign. On Tuesday, Donald Trump swept through the GOP nominating contests in
Georgia, Washington, Mississippi, and Hawaii. With daughter-in-law Lara
Trump formally taking the reins and cleaning house at the RNC this week,
with dozens of establishment loyalists forced out of work, Trump’s
stunning remaking of the Republican Party in his image is virtually
complete.

From the beginning of my campaign, I've counted on our grassroots team to
fuel our efforts and fight back against MAGA extremists. But whether it's
our well-connected, wealthy opponent Steve Garvey, the California GOP, or
the watchful eyes of reporters, everyone will be scrutinizing our FEC
report to gauge the strength of our campaign, Democrats’ overall chances
of defending the Senate, and defeating Donald Trump.

Reaching our FEC fundraising goal or falling short will produce one of two
possible narratives — that grassroots Democrats are doing everything
possible to defeat Trump, or if we’re leaving the door cracked open for
his return. We cannot fall behind.

Derek, I’m
ready to bring about meaningful change in the Senate. I’m ready to build
an economy that works for everyone. I’m ready to strengthen our democracy
with restored voting rights, stronger codes of conduct for Supreme Court
justices, and campaign finance reform. I’m ready to fight for universal
healthcare and eliminate student loan debt nationwide.

But all of these plans rely on us defending the Senate and defeating Trump
in November — and I can only do that with you by my side.

FROM: A proud Democrat
Subject: I stand with you. **_To Rep. Jamie Raskin — thank you for being one of the top defenders of our democracy!_**

First, your heroic work on the January 6th Committee EXPOSED the truth about the MAGA mob’s deadly insurrection!

Then, you introduced groundbreaking legislation to BAN Donald Trump from the ballot after far-right Supreme Court Justices let him off the hook!

**And now, you’re REFUSING to back down as Trump threatens to be a _“dictator on Day One!”_

[**I know Republicans will use every dirty trick in the book to try and silence you. So today, I’m fighting back and chipping in $3 to the Voter Protection Project to put the MAGA GOP in their place and keep electing brave Democrats like you! »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/64376?t=9&akid=13488%2E878179%2EqOsEd7)** | [Donate $3 to sign now »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/64376?t=10&akid=13488%2E878179%2EqOsEd7)

name: Alsobrooks HQ
subject: Here's the weekly Team Alsobrooks Newsletter!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alsobrooks for Senate
body:
|
---
[ ](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/2092?t=1&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj)

| | Greetings #TeamAlsobrooks, What an amazing week on the campaign trail! Thank you to all the people who came out to support us. It was truly inspiring to get the chance to speak with so many and envision a better future for Maryland! Lets go farther, together, for every Marylander. In case you missed it, here’s what’s been happening for the past week on the campaign trail and beyond: Take a look at a new video we put out this week! Angela has spent her career putting families first in pursuit of better outcomes for underserved communities. It's time for every Marylander to have their first chance at success! **[Check it out here!](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/14977?t=7&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj)** [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/14991?t=30&amount=25&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj) In Baltimore, we met with a wonderful group and discussed how we can provide first chances for all Marylanders and protect social security for our seniors in the Senate. Thank you to Cynthia Gross for gathering such an awesome group. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/14991?t=31&amount=25&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj) Thank you to the Freeman family for hosting such a lovely event in Marlow Heights. It's truly a pleasure to hear the stories of so many different people as we travel across the State, but it doesn’t stop there. We’re taking all of our stories, hopes, and dreams for our great State with us to the US Senate! [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/14991?t=32&amount=25&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj) The energy was high at our canvass launch with Higher Heights PAC in Silver Spring! Rain or shine Team Alsobrooks shows up to knock on doors, make calls, and get out the vote ahead of the May 14th election. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/14991?t=33&amount=25&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj) We had a blast in Rockville meeting so many Marylanders. Our campaign’s grassroots message is spreading, and with our momentum, we’ll win in November. The time for business as usual in Washington is over. Thank you to Senator Chris Van Hollen, Montgomery County Executive Marc Elrich, State Senator Jeff D. Waldstreicher, Delegate Jheanelle Wilkins, Delegate Lorig Charkoudian, Delegate Jared Solomon, Councilwoman Kate Stewart, Councilwoman Dawn Luedtke, and former Montgomery County Executive Ike Leggett for showing up and supporting our campaign! [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/14991?t=34&amount=25&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj) [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/14991?t=35&amount=25&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj) Thank you to Reverend Dr. Patrick Clayborn and Reverend Sheri D. Smith Clayborn for inviting us to join in service at Bethel AME. It was so great to be back in Baltimore worshiping with the community! [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/14991?t=36&amount=25&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj) We are so incredibly grateful that our 1000 Women for Alsobrooks Event was a huge success! It’s unbelievably incredible that so many super bad women from across the state came out to get fired up to vote! Thank you to our friends Congresswoman Stacey Plaskett, Congressman Kweisi Mfume, Speaker Adrienne Jones, Comptroller Brooke Lierman, County Executive Johnny Olszewski, Co-founder of Black Voters Matter LaTosha Brown, Melanie Campbell and Kellie Jackson for helping me get the crowd fired up. It’s time to go farther and do better. Let’s go win! [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/14991?t=37&amount=25&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj) [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/14991?t=25&amount=25&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj) It’s truly an honor to have the support of Representative Justin Pearson, a trailblazer and a fierce advocate in the state of Tennessee. It’s crucial we elect more leaders like Justin up and down the ballot who hold steadfast to their values and always put our democracy first. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/14991?t=26&amount=25&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj) #TeamAlsobrooks is growing more and more everyday, and we couldn't do any of this without our amazing volunteers. Thanks to the folks who stopped by our Largo office yesterday afternoon and last night to make calls to their neighbors ahead of the May 14th election. Let's win this!!! [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/14991?t=27&amount=25&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj) [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/14991?t=28&amount=25&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj) **UPCOMING EVENTS** **Saturday, March 16 (Baltimore)** – Meet and Greet Hosted by State Senator Antonio Hayes, Lisa Summers, and Chris Ryder
**Saturday, March 16 (Baltimore)** – Support Angela at the Baltimore City Central Committee Candidate Forum – **[RSVP Here](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/14132?t=8&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj) **
**Friday, March 22 (Frederick)** – Frederick Meet and Greet hosted by Dr. Denise Rollins, Guy Djoken and Sue Hecht – **[RSVP Here](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/13658?t=9&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj)**
**Saturday, March 23 (Odenton)** – Knock Doors in Odenton with Rep. Steny Hoyer and County Executive Steuart Pittman – **[RSVP Here](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/13649?t=10&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj)**
**Saturday, March 23 (Capitol Heights)** – Men for Alsobrooks Meet and Greet
**Sunday, March 24 (Owings Mills)** – Owing Mills Meet and Greet **NEWS OF THE WEEK** **[ENDORSEMENT ANNOUNCEMENT](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/14986?t=11&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj)** : Representative Stacey Plaskett **[ENDORSEMENT ANNOUNCEMENT](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/14987?t=12&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj)** : Representative Justin Pearson **[Moms Demand Action names Angela Alsobrooks Gun Sense Candidate](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/14988?t=13&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj)** **[WYPR: Angela Alsobrooks aspires to replace Senator Ben Cardin](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/14989?t=14&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj)**
_“Prince George’s County Executive Angela Alsobrooks is running in the Democratic primary to succeed Ben Cardin in the United States Senate.”_ **[Maryland Matters: New stakes in Md. Senate race following Alabama Supreme Court ruling on IVF](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/14990?t=15&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj)**
_“‘It’s not just that abortion’s on the ballot. It’s not just that IVF is on the ballot, it’s freedom...I feel determined about this burden, and that it will not fall on my daughter’s shoulder, as it has fallen on the shoulders of so many other women in our country’ Alsobrooks said at her event.”_ **GET INVOLVED** I know what you’re thinking... 🤔
Where did #TeamAlsbrooks get those cool shirts and how can I get one ??? [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12165?t=16&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj) Well the good news is, our campaign store is now live! Grab some merch you can wear to our next campaign event: **[Team Alsobrooks Store](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/12165?t=17&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj)** We’re extremely excited to announce that we’re accepting applications for our Fellowship Program aimed at high school and college students. If you know a young person looking to get some hands-on experience in politics, encourage them to **[apply here](http://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/9723?t=18&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj)**. Here on Team Alsobrooks, we’re proud to be a campaign powered by grassroots donors. We believe in Angela's ability to go further and do better for our communities, and we know you do too! It’s going to take all of us working together to get Angela over the finish line this November. | | | [Volunteer](https://alsobrooks.actionkit.com/signup/volunteer-form?t=19&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj)
---
| | [Donate](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/14991?t=29&amount=25&akid=1231%2E52803%2EEjA1rj)
---
**SOCIALS**
While we'll keep sending emails to keep you updated, the best way to keep up with Angela is on our social media channels. Follow us on Twitter, Facebook, and Instagram to follow along with us on the campaign trail!

Team Alsobrooks

Thank you to Cynthia Gross for gathering such an awesome group. Thank you to the Freeman family for hosting such a lovely event in Marlow Heights. It's truly a pleasure to hear the stories of so many different people as we travel across the State, but it doesn’t stop there. We’re taking all of our stories, hopes, and dreams for our great State with us to the US Senate! The energy was high at our canvass launch with Higher Heights PAC in Silver Spring! Rain or shine Team Alsobrooks shows up to knock on doors, make calls, and get out the vote ahead of the May 14th election. We had a blast in Rockville meeting so many Marylanders. Our campaign’s grassroots message is spreading, and with our momentum, we’ll win in November. The time for business as usual in Washington is over. Thank you to Senator Chris Van Hollen, Montgomery County Executive Marc Elrich, State Senator Jeff D. Waldstreicher, Delegate Jheanelle Wilkins, Delegate Lorig Charkoudian, Delegate Jared Solomon, Councilwoman Kate Stewart, Councilwoman Dawn Luedtke, and former Montgomery County Executive Ike Leggett for showing up and supporting our campaign! Thank you to Reverend Dr. Patrick Clayborn and Reverend Sheri D. Smith Clayborn for inviting us to join in service at Bethel AME. It was so great to be back in Baltimore worshiping with the community! We are so incredibly grateful that our 1000 Women for Alsobrooks Event was a huge success! It’s unbelievably incredible that so many super bad women from across the state came out to get fired up to vote! Thank you to our friends Congresswoman Stacey Plaskett, Congressman Kweisi Mfume, Speaker Adrienne Jones, Comptroller Brooke Lierman, County Executive Johnny Olszewski, Co-founder of Black Voters Matter LaTosha Brown, Melanie Campbell and Kellie Jackson for helping me get the crowd fired up. It’s time to go farther and do better. Let’s go win! It’s truly an honor to have the support of Representative Justin Pearson, a trailblazer and a fierce advocate in the state of Tennessee. It’s crucial we elect more leaders like Justin up and down the ballot who hold steadfast to their values and always put our democracy first. #TeamAlsobrooks is growing more and more everyday, and we couldn't do any of this without our amazing volunteers. Thanks to the folks who stopped by our Largo office yesterday afternoon and last night to make calls to their neighbors ahead of the May 14th election. Let's win this!!! UPCOMING EVENTS Saturday, March 16 (Baltimore) – Meet and Greet Hosted by State Senator Antonio Hayes, Lisa Summers, and Chris Ryder Saturday, March 16 (Baltimore) – Support Angela at the Baltimore City Central Committee Candidate Forum – Friday, March 22 (Frederick) – Frederick Meet and Greet hosted by Dr. Denise Rollins, Guy Djoken and Sue Hecht – Saturday, March 23 (Odenton) – Knock Doors in Odenton with Rep. Steny Hoyer and County Executive Steuart Pittman – Saturday, March 23 (Capitol Heights) – Men for Alsobrooks Meet and Greet Sunday, March 24 (Owings Mills) – Owing Mills Meet and Greet NEWS OF THE WEEK : Representative Stacey Plaskett : Representative Justin Pearson “Prince George’s County Executive Angela Alsobrooks is running in the Democratic primary to succeed Ben Cardin in the United States Senate.” “‘It’s not just that abortion’s on the ballot. It’s not just that IVF is on the ballot, it’s freedom...I feel determined about this burden, and that it will not fall on my daughter’s shoulder, as it has fallen on the shoulders of so many other women in our country’ Alsobrooks said at her event.” GET INVOLVED I know what you’re thinking... 🤔 Where did #TeamAlsbrooks get those cool shirts and how can I get one ??? Well the good news is, our campaign store is now live! Grab some merch you can wear to our next campaign event: We’re extremely excited to announce that we’re accepting applications for our Fellowship Program aimed at high school and college students. The cornerstone of a robust democracy is the active participation of its citizens. Offering the option to vote by mail is nonpartisan and would eliminate many of the hurdles that discourage people from voting. Derek Marshall’s opponent, Rep. Friend,

I'm the product of an unplanned pregnancy.

Born to two teenage parents, every statistic and societal roadblock indicated that I was destined for a life of hardship.

But my parents didn't buy into any of that.

I may have been unplanned, but that did not mean I was unwanted.

Soon after me, three more kids came. And what began as a teenage love story quickly became a family of six. My dad went to work and did whatever he needed to do to make ends meet for our family. That meant putting his life on the line to serve his community in the local fire department.

All my life, I wanted to be like my dad, and there was nothing I dreamed of more than becoming a firefighter just like him.

But on a fateful day in September of 1984, all of that changed.

My dad and his battalion responded to a call that would change all of our lives forever.

By the grace of God my dad made it out of that building alive, but not unscathed. Eighty percent of his body was covered in burns.

From then on, the hardest working man that I knew would not be able to work as a fireman another day of his life. And as the oldest of four kids, it was up to me to step in and help fill the void in our young family.

We're all a product of our experiences, and that moment defined who I am.

My dream of becoming a firefighter like my dad was now discouraged, and I had effectively been launched into the role of a pseudo-parent to my younger siblings overnight.

**Being raised in a Christian household without a lot of means, we put our head down for two reasons:

1\. To pray to God
2\. To get to work**

So, at 12 years old, I picked myself up by my bootstraps and did just that -- got to work.

And to be quite honest, I haven't really picked my head back up since.

>From a young boy trying to help his parents make ends meet, to a law student, to a husband and father, and eventually to Speaker of the House, the only thing I have ever been focused on is getting the job done.

My wife might call me a workaholic, but in my mind, I am a man who is focused on the task at hand, and completing a mission.

**[Right now, my mission is to ensure that my kids have the same opportunity to make a life for themselves and achieve their goals like I did.](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=c6ebfff551f645749bec952fe2598013&_e=XNizspudOP7aJDjeqBOrauCkNXuE3kjBU6KIcpjJRNnY_eeDZnKkyX4wI1A77ZgcYZp_TXIG6W0R4XuN-0Luzhz-0JjhDD9D9IEfuyzpl7c6JGWFhZ2Z5P5_nWO1tv_kH_ODlom9QhQDBqb0YZKtnFzt8a1FayJR-mmWBBMNOjIGAhLLluUOzUxemk-0EAGdjU7F6JXey7MfZOPx1gQP7Sd9qxu0zTw4HFv8z5z0Cd6h4vuDnU5EDWDScHYfTd2FwQQ2DJYeLrGMRXgT4fgSMBFW0_rAx7NRWgZaa3dCL4eI6h43o52YY7L-kQOQRulAUut5do5Mmn1HDugiQymMO1hJEG-XvsxUFnGKop_VR_C1W-UTkgPh8KuUjAmmd7Dod2TcTsKfYMqf1jdf54-X2EzQwjTce--nyUBrSq7--zkP9m_FR8OLCC7kmhIDiXef3VkJxGPg0VSS5FeuwP6jIbTnWf5dGc0ZT12Ps8ZBFZC11yiyDICzm5UNyYp9TMDsbiQMMqSXNRabhd6ONA4OTg%3D%3D "Right now, my mission is to ensure that my kids have the same opportunity to make a life for themselves and achieve their goals like I did. ")**

And that means being the kind of conservative, Christian leader in Washington, D.C. that my dad would be proud of.

That alone puts you at odds with the D.C. Establishment, by the way.

I'm not interested in the cocktail parties, or rubbing elbows with different special interest groups.

clean_body: I serve God first | | | | | | Friend, I'm the product of an unplanned pregnancy. Born to two teenage parents, every statistic and societal roadblock indicated that I was destined for a life of hardship. But my parents didn't buy into any of that. I may have been unplanned, but that did not mean I was unwanted. Soon after me, three more kids came. And what began as a teenage love story quickly became a family of six. My dad went to work and did whatever he needed to do to make ends meet for our family. That meant putting his life on the line to serve his community in the local fire department. All my life, I wanted to be like my dad, and there was nothing I dreamed of more than becoming a firefighter just like him. But on a fateful day in September of 1984, all of that changed. My dad and his battalion responded to a call that would change all of our lives forever. By the grace of God my dad made it out of that building alive, but not unscathed. Eighty percent of his body was covered in burns. From then on, the hardest working man that I knew would not be able to work as a fireman another day of his life. And as the oldest of four kids, it was up to me to step in and help fill the void in our young family. We're all a product of our experiences, and that moment defined who I am. My dream of becoming a firefighter like my dad was now discouraged, and I had effectively been launched into the role of a pseudo-parent to my younger siblings overnight. Being raised in a Christian household without a lot of means, we put our head down for two reasons: 1\. To pray to God 2\. To get to work So, at 12 years old, I picked myself up by my bootstraps and did just that -- got to work. And to be quite honest, I haven't really picked my head back up since. From a young boy trying to help his parents make ends meet, to a law student, to a husband and father, and eventually to Speaker of the House, the only thing I have ever been focused on is getting the job done. My wife might call me a workaholic, but in my mind, I am a man who is focused on the task at hand, and completing a mission. "Right now, my mission is to ensure that my kids have the same opportunity to make a life for themselves and achieve their goals like I did. " And that means being the kind of conservative, Christian leader in Washington, D.C. that my dad would be proud of. That alone puts you at odds with the D.C. Establishment, by the way. I'm not interested in the cocktail parties, or rubbing elbows with different special interest groups. The Washington Elite and their allies in the mainstream media can cast judgment all they want. That doesn't bother me. Because at the end of the day, I know that I serve an audience of one -- and that I am doing all that I can with the blessings given to me, and the faith entrusted to me, to glorify God. "So, now that you know just a little bit more about me, where I come from, and what keeps me going, I humbly ask if you are willing to stand alongside me in this fight? Just before the deadline, a former investment banker that lives in a multi-million dollar home outside of Alexandria’s district has launched his campaign to unseat her.
Alexandria’s primary is in 3 months. We need to be ready to fight back against our new opponent’s mailers, commercials, and whatever else he’ll throw at us.
**We need your help to prepare for those attacks.**
[Will you donate $5 right now to help us defeat this Wall Street millionaire calling Alexandria ‘radical’ for wanting Medicare for All? Every dollar goes to keeping Alexandria in Congress fighting for a better future for all.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240315.5FB5OL&refcode=em20240315-6011-P_FND_RES_HDL&t=1&akid=6011%2E2526796%2EqnQBPA)

Alexandria’s opponent popped up only this week because of New York’s congressional redistricting process. He had previously filed paperwork to challenge Jamaal Bowman in the Democratic primary — **but after the redistricting process was finalized, he switched to target Alexandria instead**.
Our challenger may entirely self-fund his campaign — or simply reach out for support from AIPAC or any of the special interests pouring hundreds of millions into this election to unseat the Squad and Alexandria.
Many progressives have been defeated over these last few years because they were heavily outspent. We can’t let that happen to Alexandria.
Alexandria doesn’t host fancy cocktail fundraisers asking wealthy donors for big checks — she relies only on our grassroots movement.

Forward,
Team AOC

Friend, As a former immigration attorney and a daughter of immigrants, I promise to keep speaking up for immigrants’ rights. I’ve been horrified at the dangerous anti-immigrant rhetoric and policies from Democrats in Congress and the White House. In both bodies of Congress, we’re seeing members voting for xenophobic, fear mongering bills including spending billions of our taxpayer dollars on war and on far-right U.S. border policies to end asylum protections, speed up mass deportations, and lock up more refugees. President Biden endorsed that bipartisan Senate border bill, invited Trump to “join” him in working on it, and referenced it in last week’s State of the Union address as a priority. In that State of the Union speech, the president called undocumented immigrants “illegals,” prompting a response from human rights groups to affirm that **_No human being is illegal._** We must decriminalize the deeply human act of migration, affirm the rights of all people, and finally create a real path to citizenship for our immigrant neighbors who’ve lived here for years. As Michigan United explains: **_“We need citizenship and family reunification, not detention and deportations.”_** [**Add your name today to tell Democrats in the White House and Congress: Don’t pander to far-right racists on immigration. Don’t dehumanize our immigrant neighbors. Fulfill your campaign promises to push for a more just and humane immigration process, including creating and expanding pathways to citizenship.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9HLHjcxS8SWv6yUAs25polmR9dOnEQ6Koe7KzCyuQNLpsUZ9DRDe2DY1D_G1URM0P7h36TeapRGgVmNRgBtSv4xcK0MBV9bOZes7IMwae1IjpiKgHRHFec1NFmfx1NVCPE7Zaz9uhV5UBwLM1GC1IOuj_FAAgFPp2Hx_olfoGhs7EtsVfyJAtL7s0yAx99nX4hdWCTSpPHzg2JEGWpenrPdYnWfGNJCFtJvyJOuCFPQ3a5jJaADVZrDEbeo0rvyNI72ESE8IC_zXXt8sPOa6JcZLnk32Vj_QFmkI0OBeQP23nkP7qX4LVeE9lA0QgVii9N5-VL8P-6_el1xL7t_kDOa2ZIBMEe2tL_zNqMUgJVENV1QbOrJkUiEbH58eofS6Sj6R7pr2L_bisr1OPU6UBuNWKRBn7Z_oSh6UIkWlF8QmRDMaOI7baSbTWi1Omt3lc/44o/rQ4y1cpLTr2CuicXcwcPZg/h1/h001.41NWVoddNUcSXhcwJKVKVvlWhkXj8KE4hYIRY_14WqM) | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9HLHjcxS8SWv6yUAs25polmR9dOnEQ6Koe7KzCyuQNLpsUZ9DRDe2DY1D_G1URM0P7h36TeapRGgVmNRgBtSv4xcK0MBV9bOZes7IMwae1IgTWt2-vMgSzXNwS8NOSy5TF20ED-25WcVcyh0fpsbz7-4Vy7F4QNdJbEx9fBMgehTULmwPTMiPRf9LunttTUI8lQAWDEQftsXkj0uYEzFZeexwzlA5BMaGgSoxhL9dfNiLsod3PSRctff8aVVQNgMVLdrx3OF6idlizpKBnK82mR2rfYX-X0XtjrxuV64owu6Jdk0lwUdEUCbGdEcZrtCgkL-HRYjaD8FFwO5YWUuH51QM-Y-4x_bLHpUydLuanE-dtmAJK0JbbapFHdODc3xSM_KAxFYaXS7tWjr2f5Y1YL-mw00iXD7uptILbO9or4-J9e4vBv_bqINEnYQ4nQ9q/44o/rQ4y1cpLTr2CuicXcwcPZg/h2/h001.VlRHA0-68MzpNqgI2GxMBomGIh91XCesoxFDKm7LOt8)

In my community, thousands of U.S. citizens can’t get their spouses access to a legal pathway to citizenship because of layers of bureaucracy that leave people waiting 10 or 20 years for an interview.
I’m reaffirming the promise I made to the residents of my congressional district when they sent me to Congress: I will continue taking meaningful actions to end hateful Trump-era immigration policies, reunite families, welcome migrants and asylum seekers, and reform our outdated and inhumane immigration system.
President Biden and other Democrats also made campaign promises to reduce deportations, reunite families, protect people fleeing danger, and support the millions of undocumented people who are already living and working in our communities.
But since Trump left office, deportations have increased, and many Trump-era immigration policies have continued or expanded. This “prisons first, humanity later” approach fails our immigrant communities.
The recent Senate bill, which President Biden endorsed and again referenced in his State of the Union address as a priority, would spend an unprecedented amount of taxpayer dollars to expand notoriously inhumane detention centers—including for-profit prisons that work with ICE.
The bill would also send over a billion of our tax dollars for 24-hour “suspicionless surveillance” technology that could be used to profile and harm all immigrant families in the U.S..
Kids are still in cages, and ICE still runs hundreds of abusive jails across the country as part of the world’s largest immigration detention system. Progressives and activists have talked about the need to defund ICE, not send them more money to violate more people’s rights.

Kids are still in cages, and ICE still runs hundreds of abusive jails across the country as part of the world’s largest immigration detention system. Progressives and activists have talked about the need to defund ICE, not send them more money to violate more people’s rights. Thank you. Together we can build a future with dignity and safety for all people. All to ensure that his donors foot the bill for his mounting legal fees. Corruption in all forms has absolutely no place in our politics, regardless of political party. Menendez’ support in the state has fallen, and now he is ignoring the will of the people and putting his own personal interests ahead of those of the people of New Jersey. We know that we email you a lot about corruption, but that’s because of the dangers that it poses to our democracy. In the past few years alone, we’ve seen a President that incited an insurrection and been indicted on dozens of federal charges, a Supreme Court that is facing multiple ethics scandals, and legislators who tried to overturn a free and fair election. = Our country is facing nearly unparalleled levels of corruption all the way up to the highest Court in the land. The Court has a horrible track record of having travel paid for by mega-donors, accepting undisclosed gifts, and buddying up with conservative influencers like Leonard Leo. If the Supreme Court, which is supposed to be above this unethical behavior, can be this corrupt, just imagine how quickly corruption can spread through the rest of the government. = Thank you,— Team ECU/LAV Action | | Contributions to End Citizens United//Let America Vote Action Fund are not tax deductible. about what’s happening in GA

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81054785/461229900/227139380?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNjc2ZjZiYS0yNmUzLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fj99Kv2K9BSbhSX867bczcnSM4K2TZ8ypXRSNMZYMBI=&emci=4e388938-95dd-ee11-85fb-002248223794&emdi=f676f6ba-26e3-ee11-aaf0-002248223794&ceid=43566853)

| | Peter, as the Executive Director of the Democratic Party of Georgia, I read a whole lot of news and commentary about what’s happening in Georgia and who’s going to win in November. [**_If you know you’re with us already and want to contribute to all our hard work ahead of our mid-month midnight deadline, click here instead._**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/81054786/461229901/710125701?refcode=20240315.3_KO_3AB&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNjc2ZjZiYS0yNmUzLWVlMTEtYWFmMC0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fj99Kv2K9BSbhSX867bczcnSM4K2TZ8ypXRSNMZYMBI=)

A lot of the media is trying to portray Georgia as a lock for Donald Trump. They say that Joe Biden will have to work hard if he wants to compete in Georgia – **_and that much is true. We DO need to work hard to win Georgia._**

**But what you won’t hear a lot of in the media is:_Georgia is a 50-50 tossup._**

Look at Georgia’s history.

In 2020, Georgia was the closest state in the country. Joe Biden won by just 0.23% of the votes cast. Both Senators Jon Ossoff and Rev. Warnock’s races went to runoffs, and _**both**_ won in January of 2021.

In 2021, Democrats followed up our January success with down-ballot victories across the state.

Then, in 2022, we re-elected Rev. Warnock in one of the most challenging races across the country.

And now, one of the most reliable pollsters of Georgia political opinion, the _Atlanta Journal-Constitution,_ is showing a **_one point race._**

**But that isn’t what the media wants you to think. They’ve created a narrative that Georgia is swinging back for Republicans.**_I’ll give it to you straight:_don’t believe them._ Georgia is again the closest state in the country, and we’re going to need to fight like hell to win. Please, rush a donation ahead of our midnight deadline and help us win._**

– Kevin **
